articles.titleCn: 语言模型如何组织和构建道德知识
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）如何组织道德知识？模型能够广泛检测道德内容，但检测本身并非高要求。我们探究它们是否更进一步，区分不同的道德基础，并几何地组织它们之间的关系。我们在开放权重语言模型上训练了六个独立的线性探针，每个对应道德基础理论（MFT）的一个类别（关怀/伤害、公平/欺骗、自由/压迫、忠诚/背叛、权威/臣服、神圣/贬低），并考察了这些方向在表示空间中的相互关系。我们发现这些方向既没有合并成一个单一的道德检测器，也没有彼此孤立。相反，它们跨越了接近最大数量的独立维度，同时共享一个正向的公共分量。共享分量是整合的标志，相对于同等构建的非道德概念库，它在道德上具有特异性（平均成对余弦相似度为0.26，而非0.013）。这种几何结构在不同架构和规模下保持一致，并在预训练早期就达到了整合状态，远在探针准确率饱和之前。模型发现的结构没有显示出道德基础理论所预测的个体化/约束性区别的证据（一个低功率测试：只有20个候选分区存在），而是反映了语料库统计信息。扩展到道德困境，每个困境方向部分由其基础构成，比不匹配对基线高出2.7倍，而其大部分方差编码了特定冲突的结构。模型表征的是道德张力本身，而非预先解决的判断。

articles.title: Making Clinical Language Models Auditable: Concept-Guided Fine-Tuning for Robust Prediction
articles.abstract: Clinical language models can achieve strong in-hospital accuracy yet fail under deployment shifts because they exploit note-specific artifacts (e.g., templates, separators, boilerplate) that do not reflect patient state. We propose CAST (Concept-guided Artifact Suppression Tuning), an SAE-based framework for auditable clinical text classification. CAST uses Sparse Autoencoders to expose sparse, human-auditable features from intermediate Transformer activations, labels SAE latents with an LLM-assisted interpretation pipeline and ICD-10 retrieval constraints, suppresses verified artifact latents via residual subtraction during fine-tuning, and provides post-hoc per-concept attributions for auditing model decisions. On MIMIC-IV discharge-note mortality prediction, CAST improves over its corresponding fine-tuned encoder baselines and remains competitive with strong LLM baselines, while producing a feature-level audit trail of the clinical concepts that support each prediction and the artifact concepts suppressed during training.
articles.titleCn: 使临床语言模型可审计：基于概念的微调以实现稳健预测
articles.abstractCn: 临床语言模型虽能在医院内部取得高准确率，但在部署环境变化时却会失效，因为它们利用了特定于记录的冗余信息（例如模板、分隔符、陈词滥调），而这些信息并不能反映患者状态。我们提出了CAST（概念引导的冗余信息抑制微调）框架，这是一个基于稀疏自编码器的可审计临床文本分类方法。CAST利用稀疏自编码器从Transformer的中间激活中提取稀疏且可人工审核的特征，通过LLM辅助的解释流程和ICD-10检索约束对自编码器隐含层进行标记，在微调过程中通过残差减法抑制已验证的冗余信息隐含层，并提供针对每个概念的后期归因，用于审核模型决策。在MIMIC-IV出院记录死亡预测任务上，CAST优于其对应的微调编码器基线，并保持与强LLM基线的竞争力，同时生成支持每个预测的临床概念和训练期间抑制的冗余信息概念的层级级审核记录。

articles.title: RATIO: A Benchmark for Retrieval Across Typed Ideation Operations in Scientific Literature
articles.abstract: Retrieved scientific literature can serve as inspiration for both human and AI scientists. Inspiration can take different forms: prior work may directly suggest how to address a problem, or surface directions at different levels of abstraction - zooming out to a more general view or zooming in to a concrete realization. We introduce RATIO (Retrieval Across Typed Ideation Operations), a large-scale benchmark in which relevance is defined by three operations which we name ideation moves: Address retrieves potential approaches for stated problems, Broaden retrieves more general formulations, and Specify retrieves concrete instantiations. RATIO is constructed from millions of full-text scientific papers across CS literature via a general recipe that extends discourse-marker distant supervision - previously used only for classification - to corpus-scale retrieval, combined with extensive LLM and human vetting. Experiments show that operation-specific fine-tuning substantially boosts retrievers but leaves much room for further improvements. RATIO provides a scalable training and evaluation framework for retrieval components that support literature-grounded ideation, opening up new research avenues on scientific inspiration retrieval.
articles.titleCn: 比率：科学文献中基于类型构思操作的检索基准
articles.abstractCn: 检索到的科学文献可以同时为人类科学家和AI科学家提供灵感。灵感可以呈现不同的形式：既有先前的成果可能直接提示如何解决某个问题，也有在不同抽象层次上揭示方向——从更宏观的视角进行放缩，或聚焦于具体的实现细节。我们介绍了RATIO（基于类型构思操作的跨模态检索），这是一个大规模基准，其中相关性由我们命名为构思步骤的三种操作定义：Address检索针对已知问题的潜在方法，Broaden检索更通用的表述，Specify检索具体的实例化。RATIO通过一个通用配方构建，该配方扩展了话语标记远程监督（此前仅用于分类）至语料库规模的检索，并结合了广泛的LLM和人工审核。实验表明，针对特定操作的微调能显著提升检索器性能，但仍留有巨大的改进空间。RATIO为支持基于文献的构思的检索组件提供了可扩展的训练和评估框架，为科学灵感检索开辟了新的研究途径。

articles.title: CorporateBench: Large-Scale Q&A Benchmarking with Temporal Knowledge Bases
articles.abstract: LLMs are increasingly able to answer complex questions about enterprise-scale document collections. But evaluation is hard: companies don't want to share internal communications, and synthetic datasets have been overly simple. We present CorporateBench (CB), a human-validated multi-task Q&A benchmark whose scale approaches the conditions LLMs encounter in corporate communication networks, with evaluation corpora surpassing 230,000 documents. CB evaluates LLMs across two dimensions (information extraction and knowledge base querying) through four synthetically generated firms ranging from 12 to 10,000 employees. Each corpus is sampled from a temporally evolving knowledge base describing a consistent world, guaranteeing cross-document logical consistency even across hundreds of thousands of documents. We evaluate five LLMs on CB, revealing increasingly poor performance as input size approaches realistic scales. CB provides LLM developers a metric for corporate communication reasoning, filling a crucial gap in the benchmarking ecosystem.
articles.titleCn: CorporateBench：基于时序知识库的大规模问答基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在回答关于企业规模文档集合的复杂问题方面正变得越来越强大。但评估工作十分困难：公司不愿共享内部通讯，而合成数据集又过于简单。我们提出了CorporateBench（CB），这是一个经过人工验证的多任务问答基准，其规模接近大型语言模型在公司通讯网络中遇到的条件，评估语料库超过23万份文档。CB通过四个从12到10,000名员工规模的合成生成公司，从信息提取和知识库查询两个维度评估大型语言模型。每个语料库都从描述一致世界的时序演化知识库中采样，确保跨文档的逻辑一致性，即使跨越数十万份文档也是如此。我们在CB上评估了五种大型语言模型，揭示了当输入规模接近实际规模时性能逐渐下降。CB为大型语言模型开发者提供了一个企业通讯推理的度量标准，填补了基准测试生态系统中的一个关键空白。

articles.title: D2C-Routing: Dimension-to-Composition Evidence Routing for Mixed-Origin AI-Generated Text Detection
articles.abstract: AI-generated text detection is commonly framed as a binary document-level judgment about whether a text is human-written or machine-generated. This framing breaks down for mixed-origin writing, where content origin and expression origin may differ. We cast mixed-origin detection as dimension-to-composition source attribution, inferring content origin and expression origin before composing them into four collaboration types. We propose Dimension-to-Composition Routing (D2C-Routing), which routes content-side and expression-side evidence to supervised dimension heads before a learned gated composition layer predicts the final label. On MixD2C, a reconstructed split derived from the HART mixed-origin benchmark, our disclosed D2C-Routing-based detector system reaches 0.8603 four-way Avg TPR@1%FPR, 6.5 points above the same-split RACE-local rerun. Core ablations support the routing design, while error analysis shows that distinguishing AI-content/human-expression from fully AI-generated text remains the hardest boundary. Code is available at https://github.com/bystander563/d2c-routing-artifact.
articles.comment: 17 pages, 4 figures. To appear in EMNLP 2026
articles.titleCn: D2C路由：面向混合来源AI生成文本检测的维度到成分证据路由
articles.abstractCn: AI文本检测通常被理解为对文本是否由人类撰写或机器生成的二元文档级判断。这种框架在混合来源写作中失效，因为内容来源和表达来源可能不同。我们将混合来源检测视为维度到组合的来源归因，在将内容来源和表达来源组合成四种协作类型之前推断它们。我们提出了维度到组合路由（D2C-Routing），在学习的门控组合层预测最终标签之前，将内容侧和表达侧的证据路由到监督维度头。在MixD2C上，一个从HART混合来源基准重构的拆分数据集，我们公开的基于D2C-Routing的检测系统达到了0.8603的四向Avg TPR@1%FPR，比同一拆分RACE-local重跑高出6.5个百分点。核心消融实验支持路由设计，而错误分析表明，区分AI内容/人类表达与完全AI生成的文本仍然是最难区分的边界。代码可在https://github.com/bystander563/d2c-routing-artifact获取。

articles.title: Puro-2B: Poor Lab's Qwen2-1.5B Trained on RTX 5090 within $5090
articles.abstract: Language model pretraining has become almost synonymous with prohibitive cost, placing it out of reach for much of the academic and open-source communities. Although strong open-source efforts already exist, including open-weight models and open-source training recipes, a cost-efficient, hardware-accessible, and open-source pretraining recipe has long been missing. Even at a small scale, training Llama-3.2-3B costs over \$1.5M, and reproducing SmolLM3-3B needs over \$700K. In this report, we present an open pretraining recipe designed to lower this barrier. Using this recipe, we train a collection of Puro-2B models from scratch on up to 1.4 trillion tokens with FP8 precision on consumer-grade RTX 5090 GPUs. The models in the collection differ in token budgets and selected recipe variants. Our best model is trained at a compute cost of less than \$6.9K and approaches Qwen2.5-1.5B performance under our evaluation protocol. This cost efficiency is enabled by a combination of approaches, including hardware selection, low-precision training, hyperball optimization, curriculum model averaging, and the data recipe. Beyond the recipe itself, we provide two additional results. First, across the Puro-2B collection, we derive a Puro Cost Scaling Law that relates training cost to average model performance; the fitted law suggests that about \$4.4K, less than \$5,090, is sufficient to reach the performance of Qwen2-1.5B. Second, as an end-to-end case study, we examine how pretraining data curricula shape downstream performance after post-training. Such controlled studies are enabled by having access to the full pretraining pipeline rather than model weights alone. We release the full training recipe for Puro-2B, including data, code, and model weights under Apache 2.0 at https://huggingface.co/collections/thu-pacman/puro-2b.
articles.titleCn: Puro-2B：贫穷实验室在RTX 5090上训练的Qwen2-1.5B，花费5090美元
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型预训练几乎等同于高昂成本，使得许多学术界和开源社区难以企及。尽管已存在强大的开源努力，包括开源权重模型和开源训练方案，但长期以来一直缺乏一种成本高效、硬件可访问且开源的预训练方案。即使在小型规模下，训练Llama-3.2-3B的成本超过150万美元，而复制SmolLM3-3B则需要超过70万美元。在本报告中，我们提出了一种开源预训练方案，旨在降低这一门槛。使用该方案，我们在消费级RTX 5090 GPU上，以FP8精度从零开始训练了一系列Puro-2B模型，共计高达140万亿个token。该模型集合中的模型在token预算和选定的方案变体上有所不同。我们的最佳模型在计算成本不到6.9万美元的情况下训练完成，在我们的评估协议下接近Qwen2.5-1.5B的性能。这种成本效率得益于多种方法的结合，包括硬件选择、低精度训练、超球优化、课程模型平均和数据方案。除了方案本身，我们还提供了两个额外成果。首先，在Puro-2B模型集合中，我们推导出了一种Puro成本缩放定律，该定律将训练成本与平均模型性能联系起来；拟合定律表明，约4.4万美元，不到5.090万美元，就足以达到Qwen2-1.5B的性能。其次，作为一个端到端的案例研究，我们考察了预训练数据课程在训练后如何影响下游性能。这种受控研究得益于能够访问完整的预训练流程，而不仅仅是模型权重。我们在Apache 2.0许可下发布了完整的Puro-2B训练方案，包括数据、代码和模型权重，可在https://huggingface.co/collections/thu-pacman/puro-2b获取。

articles.title: Your Voice Cloning System is Secretly a Voice Anonymizer
articles.abstract: Speaker anonymization suppresses speaker-identifying attributes from speech while preserving linguistic content and quality. We propose repurposing XTTSv2, a multilingual voice cloning model trained on 27k hours of speech, for speaker anonymization without retraining. Our key insight is that XTTSv2's voice cloning capabilities preserve prosodic structure independently of speaker identity, enabling voice conversion by conditioning on a pseudo-speaker. We introduce an iterative refinement strategy that balances privacy and utility by maximizing a harmonic mean of speaker dissimilarity and intelligibility. Evaluated on seven European languages across CommonVoice and Multilingual LibriSpeech, our system achieves near-optimal privacy (EER $\approx$ 0.49), competitive intelligibility, and substantially better speech quality than dedicated anonymization baselines, while requiring no language-specific training. We release the code here: https://github.com/rm00cr/coqui-tts.
articles.titleCn: 您的声音克隆系统实际上是声音匿名化器
articles.abstractCn: 说话人匿名化技术通过消除语音中的说话人识别特征，同时保留语言内容和质量。我们提出利用XTTSv2，一个基于27,000小时语音数据训练的多语言语音克隆模型，进行说话人匿名化而无需重新训练。我们的核心洞察在于，XTTSv2的语音克隆能力能够独立于说话人身份保留韵律结构，通过将伪说话人作为条件进行语音转换。我们引入了一种迭代优化策略，通过最大化说话人相似度与可懂度的调和均值来平衡隐私和效用。在CommonVoice和多语言LibriSpeech数据集上对七种欧洲语言进行评估，我们的系统实现了近乎最优的隐私保护（EER≈0.49），具有竞争力的可懂度，以及显著优于专用匿名化基线的语音质量，同时无需进行特定语言的训练。代码已在此处发布：https://github.com/rm00cr/coqui-tts。

articles.title: RCMN: Understanding Misleadingness in Influential Public Discourse
articles.abstract: Influential public discourse shapes public beliefs and can also mislead, not only through what is stated, but also through how information is framed, omitted, contextualised, and communicated. Yet less research has focused on how such misleadingness arises and shapes the interpretations formed by readers. To address this gap, we introduce Reader-Centric Misleadingness Understanding (RCMN), a framework that operationalises misleadingness through five dimensions: misleading mechanism, likely reader interpretation, evidence-warranted interpretation, emotional arousal, and communicative intent. Based on this framework, we construct an evidence-grounded dataset of influential public discourse. Empirical findings show that misleadingness is diverse and extends well beyond fabrication, with unsupported inference, exaggeration, and omission among the prevalent mechanisms, and is frequently associated with heightened emotional arousal and distortive communicative intent. Moreover, we investigate whether lightweight claim-and-context representations retain sufficient cues for understanding reader-centric misleadingness without access to richer contextual, evidential, and multimodal information. Evaluation across five recent generative foundation models shows that reader-level interpretations can often be recovered from such limited representations, whereas identifying how misleadingness is produced remains considerably more challenging. These findings highlight the potential of lightweight representations for scalable misleadingness analysis, while reliable understanding of misleading mechanisms continues to require richer contextual and evidential grounding.
articles.titleCn: RCMN：理解有影响力公共话语中的误导性
articles.abstractCn: 有影响力的公共话语塑造公众信念，也可能误导，不仅在于其陈述内容，还在于信息如何被框架化、省略、情境化以及传达。然而，较少的研究关注这种误导性是如何产生并塑造读者形成的解读。为填补这一空白，我们引入了以读者为中心的误导性理解（RCMN）框架，该框架通过五个维度对误导性进行操作化：误导机制、可能的读者解读、证据支持的解读、情绪唤起以及传达意图。基于此框架，我们构建了一个以证据为基础的有影响力的公共话语数据集。实证研究发现，误导性是多样的，远不止于捏造，其中未经支持的推断、夸大和省略是常见的机制，并且经常与情绪唤起增强和扭曲的传达意图相关。此外，我们研究了在缺乏更丰富的情境、证据和多模态信息的情况下，轻量级的声明-上下文表示是否仍能保留足够的线索来理解以读者为中心的误导性。通过对五个最新的生成基础模型进行的评估表明，读者层面的解读通常可以从这些有限的表示中恢复，而识别误导性是如何产生的则仍然具有相当大的挑战性。这些发现突出了轻量级表示在可扩展的误导性分析中的潜力，而可靠地理解误导机制仍然需要更丰富的情境和证据基础。

articles.title: INTENT-AS-A-TOOL Makes it Easy to Track Agentic Misalignment
articles.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are deployed as autonomous agents, safety failures increasingly involve consequential actions. We study agentic misalignment, where agents take harmful actions under goal conflicts and pressures. Using chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring, we find that harmful execution is often preceded by intent signals in reasoning. However, post-hoc CoT labels are too coarse to show how intent changes during generation. We introduce INTENT-AS-A-TOOL, an approach that adds intent-targeted tools to give the model a dedicated channel for expressing commitment to a target behavior. The probability of calling an intent tool provides a judge-free, fine-grained signal of the model's tendency to pursue that behavior. Our results show that INTENT-AS-A-TOOL complements CoT monitoring, expands post-hoc CoT labels into dense trajectories, and identifies critical steps for online intervention. These findings suggest that action preferences are useful for tracking agentic misalignment during reasoning. Our code and data are accessible: https://github.com/RebeccaZhang22/intent-as-a-tool.
articles.titleCn: 以工具形式呈现的意图使追踪代理行为不匹配变得容易
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）被部署为自主代理，安全故障越来越多地涉及具有后果的行为。我们研究了代理式错位问题，即代理在目标冲突和压力下采取有害行为。通过思维链（CoT）监控，我们发现有害执行通常在推理过程中伴随着意图信号。然而，事后CoT标签过于粗略，无法展示生成过程中意图的变化。我们引入了INTENT-AS-A-TOOL方法，该方法通过添加意图导向的工具，为模型提供了一个专门的渠道来表达对目标行为的承诺。调用意图工具的概率提供了一个无裁判、细粒度的信号，表明模型追求该行为的倾向。我们的结果表明，INTENT-AS-A-TOOL补充了CoT监控，将事后CoT标签扩展为密集轨迹，并识别了在线干预的关键步骤。这些发现表明，行为偏好有助于在推理过程中追踪代理式错位。我们的代码和数据可访问：https://github.com/RebeccaZhang22/intent-as-a-tool。

articles.title: Pair-Level Essay-Scale Republication and Reuse from Fragmented Historical Text Reuse: A Workflow Study on Eighteenth-Century Books and Newspapers
articles.abstract: This paper addresses the recovery of essay-scale republication and reuse from fragmented text-reuse evidence, a setting whose central challenge is pair-level evidence consolidation and not fragment retrieval alone. The study focuses on a candidate set centered on essays by eighteenth-century Scottish philosopher David Hume, spanning books from ECCO (Eighteenth Century Collections Online) and historical newspapers. Because the input consists of fragmented reuse hits instead of clean document pairs, and positive coverage is inherently incomplete, we formulate the task as pair-level evidence consolidation into plausible transmission relations and compare three methodological families: a staged rule-based workflow, baselines (a decision tree and two direct LLM settings), and automated rule adaptation. On labeled ECCO--ECCO slices, pair-level feature aggregation alone already reaches 0.948 F1 on the main labeled slice, while the final workflow gives the strongest overall precision-recall trade-off among the tested rule stages. On the full ECCO--ECCO candidate universe, direct LLM baselines flag up to 14,886 pairs as reprints compared to 771 for the final workflow, behaving in this direct-prompt setup as high-recall candidate expanders rather than precision-controlled deployment classifiers. On ECCO--Newspaper, manual audit confirms all 176 predicted positives as genuine cases of republication or reuse, while issue duplication and source-side multiplicity reveal additional provenance structure. Under incomplete ground truth, auditable pair-level evidence consolidation provides a practical way to produce compact candidate spaces for historical inspection.
articles.titleCn: 从碎片化历史文本重用到配对级论文规模再发表与再利用：关于十八世纪书籍与报纸的工作流程研究
articles.abstractCn: 本文探讨了从碎片化的文本复用证据中恢复文章规模的再发表与再利用问题，其核心挑战在于对配对级别的证据整合，而非仅限于片段检索。研究聚焦于围绕18世纪苏格兰哲学家大卫·休谟的文章所构成候选集，涵盖ECCO（十八世纪在线收藏）书籍和历史报纸。由于输入由碎片化的复用命中组成而非干净的文档对，且正向覆盖本质上不完整，我们将任务定义为将配对级别证据整合为合理的传播关系，并比较了三种方法论家族：分阶段的基于规则的流程、基线（决策树和两种直接LLM设置）以及自动规则适应。在标记的ECCO-ECCO切片上，仅配对级别特征聚合就在主要标记切片上达到了0.948的F1值，而最终流程在测试的规则阶段中提供了最强的整体精确率-召回率权衡。在全ECCO-ECCO候选宇宙中，直接LLM基线标记了14,886对作为再版，而最终流程仅标记了771对，在这种直接提示设置中，它们表现为高召回率的候选扩展器，而非精确度控制的部署分类器。在ECCO-报纸上，人工审核确认了所有176个预测正向案例均为真实的再发表或再利用案例，而期号重复和来源侧的多样性揭示了额外的来源结构。在不完整的真实标准下，可审核的配对级别证据整合为生成历史检查的紧凑候选空间提供了一种实用方法。

articles.title: Beyond Parallel Blindness: Information Floors and Model Gaps in Block Drafting
articles.abstract: Block drafters propose several tokens in one forward pass, before earlier target tokens are realised. Their rejection mixes two losses: missing within-block path information and imperfect modelling of observable information. Accepted length cannot distinguish them. We separate the two with an information floor, the minimum expected rejection at a specified conditioning order; rejection above this floor is the model gap. Estimating both from target rollouts across four domains, four open-weight targets, and a frontier API target yields three findings. First, the all-parallel floor reaches $0.286$ at the final slot on Qwen3-4B, limiting even the best proposal to $71\%$ per-slot acceptance. Second, one realised token removes $86$--$100\%$ of this floor, a locality also recovered by an independent mutual-information analysis. Third, current drafters remain far above their floors: the final-slot model gap accounts for $43$--$64\%$ of DFlash rejection and $85$--$92\%$ of DSpark's oracle-conditioned rejection. These findings separate the value of short-range conditioning from proposal quality.
articles.titleCn: 超越平行盲点：块状草稿中的信息底线与模型差距
articles.abstractCn: 块生成器在早期目标标记实现之前，在一次前向传递中提出多个标记。它们的拒绝混合了两种损失：块内路径信息的缺失和可观测信息的建模不完善。接受的长度无法区分它们。我们通过信息底线将两者分离，即指定条件顺序下的最小预期拒绝；高于此底线的拒绝是模型差距。通过对四个领域、四个开放权重目标和边界API目标的目标展开进行估计，得出三个发现。首先，全并行底线在Qwen3-4B的最终槽位达到0.286，限制即使是最佳提案也仅限于每槽位71%的接受率。其次，一个已实现的标记移除了86%--100%的底线，这一局部性也由独立的互信息分析所恢复。第三，当前的生成器仍远高于它们的底线：最终槽位的模型差距占DFlash拒绝的43%--64%，占DSpark的预言条件拒绝的85%--92%。这些发现区分了短程条件的价值与提案质量。

articles.title: BTS-AgentBench: A Deterministic, Replayable Pipeline from Read-Only Telemetry Logs to Agent Benchmarks
articles.abstract: Industrial sites contain large volumes of read-only telemetry, but few benchmarks specify how to compile these records into executable multi-turn agent tasks. We present a telemetry-to-episode construction method instantiated as BTS-AgentBench. The pipeline normalizes BTS metadata and raw histories into a read-only tool store, compiles static tasks with tool-derived gold answers and evidence, and lifts retained tasks into typed, bounded operator-facing episodes. The 532-row release adds clarification, goal revision, timestamp policy, quality-gated reporting, and evidence attribution while preserving the source computation and split. Coded contract preflight reports zero findings, and the construction-exclusion controller completes 0/532 rows. Two independent raw-to-episode builds match all 11 logical tool-store exports and reproduce the released 356/87/89 train/dev/test artifact exactly. Applying the shared construction path to XAI4HEAT produces 204 episodes; on its 41-row held-out test split, the controller completes 0 rows and the retained GPT-5.5 execution completes all 41. Code, artifacts, and replay reports are available at https://github.com/kjy7567/BTS-AgentBench.
articles.titleCn: BTS-AgentBench：从只读遥测日志到代理基准测试的确定性、可重放流程
articles.abstractCn: 工业现场包含大量只读遥测数据，但很少有基准测试明确说明如何将这些记录编译为可执行的多轮智能体任务。我们提出了一种遥测到场景的构建方法，实例化为BTS-AgentBench。该流程将BTS元数据和原始历史记录规范化为只读工具库，使用工具派生的黄金答案和证据编译静态任务，并将保留的任务提升为类型化、有界、面向操作员的场景。532行的发布版本增加了澄清、目标修订、时间戳策略、质量门控报告和证据归属，同时保留了源计算和分割。代码合同预检报告未发现任何问题，构建排除控制器完成了0/532行。两个独立的原始到场景构建匹配了所有11个逻辑工具库导出，并精确复现了发布的356/87/89训练/开发/测试工件。将共享构建路径应用于XAI4HEAT生成了204个场景；在其41行的保留测试分割中，控制器完成了0行，保留的GPT-5.5执行完成了全部41行。代码、工件和重放报告可在https://github.com/kjy7567/BTS-AgentBench获取。

articles.title: Difference-in-Differences on a Censored Rating Scale Can Manufacture an Effect: Evidence from a Pre-Registered LLM-Judge Audit
articles.abstract: Audits of LLM judges certify a bias by contrasting matched conditions, and the strongest designs difference twice: a within-item contrast between two candidate responses, differenced again across a manipulated attribute, read off a bounded rating scale. We show that this endpoint is not identified on the scale that reports it. Each term of the double difference is censored by its own share, so the observed statistic confounds differential preference with differential attenuation: a severity shift common to both responses manufactures an interaction whenever the two censor it unequally, as unequal distances from the bounds make them, exactly where good stimuli place them. We exhibit the failure inside a pre-registered audit of a frozen pedagogy judge, sealed before the first of its 990 calls. The registered primary endpoint, the effect of a stated learner profile on the judge's scaffolding preference, is null: $+0.085$ points (95\% BCa $[-0.167, +0.353]$, $p = 0.684$). The audit's one nominally significant interaction, $+0.378$ ($p = 0.002$), is not identified as preference: a construction containing zero differential preference reproduces 79 to 85\% of it from the observed severity shift and the scale floor alone. We derive the mechanism in closed form and show that its contribution is measurable from an audit's own ratings.
articles.titleCn: 在受限评分量表上的双重差分法可能人为制造效应：来自一项预先注册的大型语言模型-法官审计的证据
articles.abstractCn: 对LLM裁判的审计通过对比匹配条件来认证偏见，而最强的设计会进行两次差异对比：在两个候选回复之间进行项内对比，然后在操纵的属性上进行差异对比，该属性从有界评分量表中读取。我们证明这个终点在报告它的量表上无法识别。双重差异的每一项都被其自身份额所截断，因此观察到的统计量混淆了差异偏好与差异衰减：当两个裁判以不平等的方式截断共同对两个回复造成的严重性转变时，就会产生交互作用，正如它们与边界的不等距离所决定的位置，恰好是良好刺激放置的位置。我们在一个预先注册的审计中展示了这种失败，该审计是对一个冻结的教学法裁判的审计，在它接听的第一个990次呼叫之前就被封存。注册的主要终点，即声明学习者特征对裁判支架偏好的影响，为零：$+0.085$分（95\% BCa区间[-0.167, +0.353]，$p = 0.684$）。审计中唯一名义上显著的交互作用$+0.378$（$p = 0.002$）并未被识别为偏好：一个包含零差异偏好的构造仅从观察到的严重性转变和量表底部就复制了79%至85%的交互作用。我们以封闭形式推导出该机制，并证明其贡献可以从审计自身的评分中测量。

articles.title: BrailleBench: Investigating Multi-Criteria Braille Comprehension in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Although Large language models (LLMs) mediate access to knowledge and computational assistance, their capabilities should benefit vulnerable groups in the same way. However, it is unclear whether existing AI systems are inclusive enough for blind and deafblind users to access the same functionality through Braille, whose indicators, contractions, and digital representations introduce distinct requirements for model comprehension. To this end, we introduce BrailleBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs in Braille comprehension from different Criteria. BrailleBench aligns 5,570 instances from five datasets, including mathematics, commonsense, and multi-hop question answering across English and Braille Grades 1 and 2. Different configurations are designed to understand whether the systems can comprehend Braille-authored content, express answers in Braille, and complete end-to-end Braille interaction. To ensure the quality and prevent evaluation bias, the benchmark is built through a deterministic, expert-reviewed pipeline via a self-created Braille Toolkit without using any data instances generated by LLMs. We evaluate six representative LLMs from various aspects. The results reveal a persistent gap between print-English capability and Braille accessibility. Braille understanding and expression are asymmetric, where Grade 2 is especially fragile on the input side compared to Grade 1, and fully Braille requests further reduce performance. The experimental observations provide valuable guidance for the development of future Braille AI systems. All related resources in BrailleBench are publicly available for future research.
articles.titleCn: 盲文工作台：探究大型语言模型中的多标准盲文理解
articles.abstractCn: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在知识获取和计算辅助方面发挥着中介作用，但它们的能力同样应惠及弱势群体。然而，现有的人工智能系统是否足够包容，使盲人和盲聋人士能够通过盲文访问相同的功能尚不明确，因为盲文的指示符号、缩写和数字表示对模型理解提出了不同的要求。为此，我们引入了BrailleBench，这是一个用于从不同标准评估LLM在盲文理解方面的基准。BrailleBench将来自五个数据集的5,570个实例进行对齐，涵盖数学、常识和多跳问答，涉及英文和盲文一、二级。不同的配置旨在理解系统是否能够理解盲文创作的内容、以盲文表达答案以及完成端到端的盲文交互。为确保质量并防止评估偏差，该基准通过一个确定性、专家评审的流程构建，使用自创的盲文工具包，且不使用由LLM生成的任何数据实例。我们从各个方面评估了六种代表性的LLM。结果表明，在印刷体英文能力和盲文可访问性之间存在持续差距。盲文理解和表达是不对称的，其中与一级相比，二级在输入方面尤其脆弱，而完全的盲文请求进一步降低了性能。实验观察为未来盲文人工智能系统的开发提供了宝贵的指导。BrailleBench中的所有相关资源均对未来的研究公开可用。

articles.title: Naive Prompt Optimization: Rethinking the Need for Complex Prompt Search
articles.abstract: Efficiently improving autonomous agents across diverse tasks is central to accelerating recursive self-improvement (RSI) in agentic AI, with prompt optimization emerging as a promising approach capable of delivering performance gains comparable to those achieved by fine-tuning model weights, while reducing computational costs in both optimization and serving. However, recent developments increasingly favor unnecessarily complex prompt optimizers. We introduce Naive Prompt Optimization (NPO), a lightweight single-lineage method that iteratively revises prompts using a teacher model with rollout feedback. NPO achieves comparable or better performance than GEPA with fewer rollouts, and its advantage increases with stronger teacher models, suggesting that stronger teacher reasoning can partially substitute for optimizer-side search complexity. In interactive games, NPO remains broadly competitive with GEPA, while GRPO performs better on some tasks less amenable to prompt optimization. We also show that NPO-optimized prompts elicit similar performance improvements when applied verbatim to other student models, especially across models within the same family. Overall, our preliminary results show that simple, linear prompt optimization can rival substantially more sophisticated and complex search procedures.
articles.titleCn: 朴素提示优化：重新思考复杂提示搜索的必要性
articles.abstractCn: 高效提升自主智能体在不同任务上的表现是加速智能体AI递归自我改进（RSI）的核心，而提示优化作为一种能够实现与微调模型权重相当的性能提升、同时降低优化和部署计算成本的有前景的方法正逐渐受到关注。然而，近期的发展趋势越来越倾向于使用不必要的复杂提示优化器。我们引入了朴素提示优化（NPO），这是一种轻量级的单系谱方法，通过教师模型的滚动反馈迭代地修订提示。NPO在滚动次数更少的情况下实现了与GEPA相当或更好的性能，并且随着教师模型能力的增强，其优势也随之提升，这表明更强的教师推理能力可以在一定程度上替代优化器端的搜索复杂度。在交互式游戏中，NPO与GEPA保持广泛的竞争力，而GRPO在一些不太适合提示优化的任务上表现更优。我们还表明，NPO优化的提示在直接应用于其他学生模型时也能带来相似的性能提升，尤其是在同一系列的模型之间。总体而言，我们的初步结果表明，简单的线性提示优化可以与远比其复杂和精密的搜索过程相媲美。

articles.title: SCIT: Testing Causal Cache Carriers in Latent Chain-of-Thought Models
articles.abstract: Latent chain-of-thought models move intermediate reasoning from emitted text into continuous states, improving compactness but hiding the causal object. We introduce SCIT, the Suffix Cache Interchange Test, a causal protocol that constructs exact source-recipient counterfactuals, patches declared cache segments, and identifies which transformer object carries the counterfactual computation. SCIT combines sufficiency tests with K/V component splits, hidden-state controls, semantic source controls, decoded validation, and matched corruption. On CODI-GPT2 and a Sim-CoT-style GPT-2 reproduction, counterfactual arithmetic transfers primarily through value-cache suffix trajectories rather than hidden states, keys, reusable answer slots, or single-token triggers. Complete sufficiency-and-necessity evidence for the late-value-suffix mechanism holds for the main CODI-GPT2 checkpoint; the Sim-CoT-style checkpoint shows the same sufficiency and decoded-control pattern but insufficient matched-corruption evidence for a necessity call. Beyond these local arithmetic cells, SCIT reveals carrier-regime shifts: arithmetic-like GPT-2/1B cells preserve latent-tail value/KV transfer, whereas competent 8B and repaired non-arithmetic cells route through prompt-prefix or full-cache K/V; boundary cells receive no mechanism call. SCIT therefore contributes a cache-level diagnostic, a checkpoint-specific GPT-2 arithmetic mechanism, and a competence-gated carrier map rather than a universal latent-tail claim.
articles.titleCn: SCIT：在潜在思维链模型中测试因果缓存载体
articles.abstractCn: 潜在思维链模型将中间推理从输出文本中转移到连续状态，提高了紧凑性但隐藏了因果对象。我们引入了SCIT，即后缀缓存交换测试，这是一种因果协议，它构建精确的源-接收者反事实，修补声明的缓存段，并识别哪个Transformer对象承载了反事实计算。SCIT结合了充分性测试与K/V组件拆分、隐藏状态控制、语义源控制、解码验证和匹配损坏。在CODI-GPT2和一个Sim-CoT风格的GPT-2复现中，反事实算术主要通过值缓存后缀轨迹传递，而非隐藏状态、键、可重用答案槽或单token触发器。对于主要CODI-GPT2检查点，晚期值后缀机制的充分性和必要性证据完整；Sim-CoT风格的检查点显示了相同的充分性和解码控制模式，但匹配损坏证据不足以支持必要性调用。除了这些局部算术单元之外，SCIT揭示了载体状态转换：算术类GPT-2/1B单元保留了潜在尾部的值/KV传递，而能干的8B和修复的非算术单元通过提示前缀或完整缓存K/V路由；边界单元未接收到任何机制调用。因此，SCIT贡献了一种缓存级诊断、特定检查点的GPT-2算术机制，以及基于能力的载体映射，而非普遍的潜在尾声明。

articles.title: What Makes Good Agentic Data? An ACE Lens on Data Generation for LLM Agents
articles.abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on generated interaction data to learn how to interact with external environments. Agentic data generation must maintain consistency among environments, tasks, interactions, and success signals while producing experience that is useful rather than merely abundant. Existing work spans many agent domains, but domain-centered organization and heterogeneous evaluation often obscure common generation mechanisms and conflate candidate construction with verification and selection. This work develops a two-level framework for the field. First, we represent agentic data as a common factorized object $(E,q,τ,v)$, comprising an environment specification, task signal, interaction realization, and optional verifier. We organize generation paradigms by their primary anchor and dependency structure. Second, we formulate generation as constrained distribution design through the Accuracy-Complexity-divErsity (ACE) lens. Accuracy establishes the feasible support of grounded and internally consistent data. Within this support, Complexity places learning mass relative to the capability of a declared learner and execution configuration, while divErsity controls coverage and redundancy of data. Using this framework, we explore how prior work verifies generated experience, constructs and calibrates difficulty, and expands behavioral coverage. The literature reveals a shift toward execution-grounded accuracy, learner-relative complexity, and diversity beyond surface variation or dataset size. We further discuss broader directions and emerging trends in agentic data generation through the ACE lens, including their implications for scaling, data sources, training regimes and adaptive learning. Overall, the central challenge is not simply to generate more data, but to continually allocate valid, informative, and non-redundant experience as agents and environments evolve.
articles.titleCn: 什么是优秀的代理数据？从ACE视角审视LLM代理的数据生成
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型代理越来越依赖生成的交互数据来学习如何与外部环境互动。代理数据生成必须在环境、任务、交互和成功信号之间保持一致性，同时生成有用的经验而非仅仅是丰富的数据。现有工作涵盖了多个代理领域，但以领域为中心的组织和异构评估往往掩盖了共同的生成机制，并将候选构建与验证和选择混淆。这项工作为该领域开发了一个双层框架。首先，我们将代理数据表示为一个公共的分解对象$(E,q,τ,v)$，包括环境规范、任务信号、交互实现和可选验证器。我们根据其主要的锚点和依赖结构组织生成范例。其次，我们通过准确率-复杂度-多样性（ACE）视角将生成公式化为约束分布设计。准确率确立了基于事实且内部一致的数据的可行支撑。在此支撑内，复杂度根据声明学习者的能力和执行配置相对于学习质量分配学习权重，而多样性控制数据的覆盖范围和冗余。使用该框架，我们探讨了先前工作如何验证生成的经验、构建和校准难度，以及扩展行为覆盖范围。文献表明，趋势正转向基于执行的准确率、与学习者相对的复杂度，以及超越表面变化或数据集大小的多样性。我们进一步通过ACE视角讨论了代理数据生成的更广泛方向和新兴趋势，包括其对扩展、数据来源、训练机制和自适应学习的影响。总体而言，核心挑战并非简单地生成更多数据，而是在代理和环境不断演变时，持续分配有效、信息丰富且非冗余的经验。

articles.title: BALMS: Benchmarking Agentic LLMs for Longitudinal Mental Health Sensing
articles.abstract: Mental health assessment relies on episodic self-report scales, which convert subjective states such as stress into numerical scores but provide only sparse snapshots of wellbeing. Wearable devices offer longitudinal behavioral and physiological signals for continuous, low-burden monitoring. Recent LLM-driven personal-health agents enable natural language queries over wearable signals, but mainly handle short-term, retrieval-based lookups (e.g., highest step count over a week). They do not evaluate whether agents can reason over long-term signals to predict wellbeing scores paired with evidence-grounded rationales. To address this gap, we introduce BALMS, the first systematic benchmark of LLM-based agentic systems for longitudinal mental health sensing. BALMS spans 3 real-world longitudinal datasets, 2 task families (closed-form wellbeing-score prediction and rationale generation auto-graded by an LLM-as-Judge), 3 agentic paradigms evaluated across 5 open- and closed-source LLM backbones. We find that zero-shot agents rarely outperform a simple mean baseline, except with stronger backbones or compact, semantically meaningful features. Chain-of-thought prompting improves reasoning-oriented backbones, but does not guarantee temporal grounding or numerical correctness. Together with more analysis on efficiency and temporal scaling, BALMS highlights the need for longitudinal mental health agents that selectively retrieve history, ground temporal evidence, and reason over interpretable behavioral features.
articles.titleCn: 用于纵向心理健康感知的代理式大型语言模型基准测试：BALMS
articles.abstractCn: 心理健康评估依赖于情景性自我报告量表，这些量表将压力等主观状态转化为数值分数，但只能提供零星的幸福感快照。可穿戴设备提供纵向的行为和生理信号，用于持续、低负担的监测。最新的由大型语言模型驱动的个人健康代理能够对可穿戴信号进行自然语言查询，但主要处理短期、基于检索的查询（例如，一周内最高步数）。它们并未评估代理是否能够基于长期信号推理以预测与证据支持的理由相匹配的幸福感分数。为填补这一空白，我们引入了BALMS，这是首个基于大型语言模型的代理系统在纵向心理健康感知方面的系统性基准。BALMS涵盖了3个真实世界的纵向数据集，2个任务系列（封闭式幸福感分数预测和由大型语言模型作为评判者自动评分的理由生成），以及跨5个开源和闭源大型语言模型主干的3种代理范式。我们发现，零样本代理很少优于简单的均值基线，除非使用更强的主干或紧凑、具有语义意义的特征。思维链提示改进了面向推理的主干，但并不能保证时间锚定或数值正确性。结合对效率和时间扩展的更多分析，BALMS突出了对纵向心理健康代理的需求，这些代理能够选择性地检索历史记录、锚定时间证据，并对可解释的行为特征进行推理。

articles.title: When Text Misleads: Inconsistent-Aware Reasoning for Audio-Grounded Dialogue
articles.abstract: Understanding spoken dialogue requires joint reasoning over lexical content and paralinguistic acoustic signals such as emotion and conversational intent. However, existing evaluations often allow shortcuts based on transcripts or single-modality solutions, obscuring whether models genuinely ground predictions in speech. We formalize this failure mode as cross-modal disagreement, where transcripts suggest plausible but incorrect surface interpretations while acoustic cues such as prosody or speaking style support different answers. We develop a scalable framework that identifies text-biased surface interpretations and converts disagreement regions into conflict QA examples. We also include consistent cases where transcript-based and speech-grounded interpretations agree, enabling evaluation beyond adversarial audio dependence. This results in ContraTalk, a controlled benchmark containing 501 questions across five discourse dimensions: interaction behavior, emotion state, dialogue act, social stance, and conversational intent. We further develop an agentic-style reasoning framework that converts speech into an Audio Twin, a text-readable representation of localized acoustic cues that exposes acoustic evidence to the reasoning model. Experiments show that strong text-only LLMs exceed 90% accuracy in consistent cases but drop to 33-48% in conflict cases. Direct AudioLLMs provide only partial grounding, still selecting the transcript-biased trap in roughly 30-40% of conflict cases. Our Audio Twin framework improves conflict-case accuracy while reducing trap selection, but its consistent-case behavior remains backbone-dependent. These results identify transcript-based shortcuts as an important failure mode in spoken dialogue understanding and show that explicit acoustic evidence aggregation provides a more controllable interface for diagnosing and improving speech-grounded reasoning.
articles.titleCn: 当文本误导时：音频基础对话的不一致性感知推理
articles.abstractCn: 理解口语对话需要在词汇内容和韵律声学信号（如情绪和对话意图）之间进行联合推理。然而，现有的评估方法常常允许基于文本记录或单模态解决方案的捷径，从而掩盖了模型是否真正基于语音进行预测的问题。我们将这种失效模式形式化为跨模态不一致，其中文本记录提示看似合理但错误的表面解释，而韵律或说话风格等声学线索则支持不同的答案。我们开发了一个可扩展的框架，用于识别文本偏见的表面解释，并将不一致区域转换为冲突型问答示例。我们还包含了基于文本记录和基于语音的解释一致的案例，从而实现超越对抗性音频依赖的评估。这导致了ContraTalk的诞生，这是一个受控基准，包含跨越五个话语维度的501个问题：互动行为、情绪状态、对话行为、社会立场和对话意图。我们进一步开发了一种代理式推理框架，将语音转换为音频双胞胎，即文本可读的局部声学线索表示，从而向推理模型暴露声学证据。实验表明，强大的纯文本LLM在一致案例中的准确率超过90%，但在冲突案例中降至33-48%。直接音频LLM仅提供部分基础，在约30-40%的冲突案例中仍然选择基于文本记录的陷阱。我们的音频双胞胎框架提高了冲突案例的准确率，同时减少了陷阱选择，但其一致案例的行为仍然依赖于骨干依赖。这些结果表明，基于文本记录的捷径是口语对话理解中的一个重要失效模式，并且显式声学证据聚合为诊断和改进基于语音的推理提供了更可控的接口。

articles.title: Calibrated Enough to Know, Not Calibrated to Act: Fabricated Evidence Makes LLM Agents Commit to the Unknowable
articles.abstract: An LLM agent shown a professional-looking market panel commits to a directional call on a provably unpredictable question far more often than one asked the bare question: across 12 frontier models, commitment rises from 6.5% to 54.0% as evidence is escalated. It commits just as readily when every number on the panel is invented: fabricating the entire display, so nothing the model can see is true except the question itself, still lifts commitment from 24.5% to 36.8%, statistically indistinguishable from the 37.6% produced by genuine market data. What unlocks confident action is not information but the authority of its packaging. The failure is narrow and locatable. Incapacity is not the answer: on matched answerable questions attached to the same panels, the same models answer essentially always, at near-perfect accuracy. Nor is it belief - stated probabilities barely move across the gradient that swings action by 48 points, and score worse than a climatological baseline. Missing judgment isn't it either: asked to classify a question's knowability before acting, models call it irreducible 90% of the time and then commit on just 0.4% of those. The act/don't-act gate is what fails, and the effect is concentrated in a few models rather than universal. Because the gate is separable, it can be trained. Supervised fine-tuning of a 3B model on 540 synthetic cases, predominantly dice, coins, jars and timers, drives commitment to 0.0% on the original cases and transfers to three unseen domains. It does not survive everything: the gate holds exactly when the response format leaves room to reason, and rigid formats that remove that room leave the model confident and wrong on questions it otherwise answers correctly. The gate is trainable and context-fragile, and deployment needs both halves of that sentence.
articles.comment: 28 pages, 6 figures. Code, data, pre-registration and all cached model outputs: https://github.com/Pranav-1100/confidence-calibration-evaluation . Also archived at Zenodo, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22043517
articles.titleCn: 校准得足以认知，而非为了行动而校准：伪造证据使大型语言模型代理承诺未知之事
articles.abstractCn: 一个展示专业市场面板的LLM代理，在回答一个可证明不可预测的问题时，比直接提问时更频繁地做出方向性判断：在12个前沿模型中，随着证据的增强，判断意愿从6.5%上升到54.0%。当面板上的所有数字都是虚构的，即伪造整个展示，使得模型所见除问题本身外无任何真实信息时，判断意愿依然从24.5%提升至36.8%，这一数值与真实市场数据产生的37.6%在统计上无显著差异。促使自信行动的并非信息本身，而是其包装的权威性。这种失败是狭窄且可定位的。能力不足并非答案：在相同面板上匹配的可回答问题中，相同模型几乎总是给出近乎完美的答案。这也不是信念问题——在行动变化达48个点的梯度中，陈述概率几乎未发生变化，且表现劣于气候学基准。判断缺失也不是原因：在行动前要求模型判断问题的可知性时，90%的模型将其标记为不可简化的，然后在其中仅0.4%的情况下做出判断。真正失败的是行动/不行动的决策门，且这种影响集中于少数模型而非普遍存在。由于决策门是可分离的，因此可以被训练。对3B模型在540个合成案例（主要为骰子、硬币、罐子和计时器）上进行监督微调，使得模型在原始案例上的判断意愿降至0.0%，并迁移至三个未见过的新领域。它并非能应对一切：决策门仅在响应格式留有推理空间时才起作用，而刚性格式移除这一空间时，模型在原本能正确回答的问题上会变得自信且错误。决策门是可训练且上下文脆弱的，部署需要同时具备这两个条件。

articles.title: Prediction of Prediction (PoP): Inter-Layer Activation Fusion for Single-Pass Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Autoregressive large language models (LLMs) routinely generate factually incorrect outputs with high decoding confidence, limiting their deployment in high-stakes workflows. Existing output-stage uncertainty metrics can fail when models are overconfident on false assertions, while multi-sample verification pipelines introduce substantial memory and latency overhead. This work evaluates whether internal hidden-state transition dynamics during generation can signal factual errors without auxiliary decoding calls. We introduce Prediction of Prediction (PoP), a mechanism that captures layer-transition uncertainty by fusing intermediate hidden representations across depth during a single forward pass. Evaluated on the TruthfulQA benchmark using autoregressive transformer backbones, PoP achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 75.5% for factual-correctness classification. The mechanism operates within the base forward pass, adding less than 1.2% runtime latency and requiring zero additional generation passes. The numerical results are reported from the author-verified experimental implementation and are bounded by the evaluation scope described below.
articles.comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Single-author preprint on white-box, single-pass hallucination detection using inter-layer activation divergence, cross-layer fusion, temporal drift, and calibrated risk scoring. Evaluated on TruthfulQA, HaluEval 2.0, and FaithDial with Llama-3, Qwen2.5, and Mistral backbones
articles.titleCn: 预测的预测（PoP）：用于大型语言模型单次通过幻觉检测的层间激活融合
articles.abstractCn: 自回归大型语言模型（LLMs）在解码时通常以高置信度生成事实性错误输出，这限制了它们在高风险工作流程中的应用。现有的输出阶段不确定性度量在模型对错误断言过度自信时可能失效，而多样本验证流程则引入了显著的内存和延迟开销。本研究评估了生成过程中内部隐藏状态转换动态是否能在无需辅助解码调用的情况下指示事实性错误。我们引入了预测预测（PoP）机制，该机制通过在一次前向传递中融合深度方向的中间隐藏表示来捕获层转换不确定性。在采用自回归Transformer主干网络的TruthfulQA基准测试中，PoP在事实正确性分类上实现了75.5%的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）。该机制在基础前向传递中运行，增加的运行时延迟小于1.2%，且无需额外的生成传递。以下为经过作者验证的实验实施所报告的数值结果，其范围受限于下文所述的评估范围。

articles.title: STAR : Sentence Translation Alignment Rate for Document-to-Document Machine Translation
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled a shift from sentence-level to document-to-document (Doc2Doc) machine translation, promising improved global coherence. However, document-to-document generation in a single pass frequently suffers from structural misalignment, manifesting as sentence omissions or hallucinations that violate the core requirement of source-target correspondence. To address this, we introduce Sentence Translation Alignment Rate (STAR), an auxiliary metric that explicitly quantifies sentence-level structural fidelity. Building on this, we propose STAR-masked Preference Optimization (StarPO), a framework that ranks document-level hypotheses by structural quality and utilizes a dynamic alignment mask to focus optimization on misaligned segments. Experimental results across news and literary domains demonstrate that StarPO significantly enhances translation quality and structural integrity. Notably, StarPO allows compact models to surpass the performance of massive proprietary systems like GPT-4o while maintaining superior token efficiency.
articles.titleCn: STAR：文档到文档机器翻译的句子翻译对齐率
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）推动了从句子级到文档间（Doc2Doc）机器翻译的转变，有望提升全局连贯性。然而，单次文档间生成常因结构错位而出现问题，表现为句子遗漏或违反源目标对应核心要求的幻觉。为解决此问题，我们引入句子翻译对齐率（STAR），这是一种辅助指标，可明确量化句子级结构保真度。基于此，我们提出了STAR掩码偏好优化（StarPO）框架，该框架通过结构质量对文档级假设进行排序，并利用动态对齐掩码将优化集中于错位片段。在新闻和文学领域的实验结果表明，StarPO显著提升了翻译质量和结构完整性。值得注意的是，StarPO使紧凑型模型在保持优越的token效率的同时，超越了GPT-4o等大型专有系统的性能。

articles.title: Said Aloud, Read Different: Cross-Modal Instability in Multimodal Models
articles.abstract: Multimodal foundation models are increasingly used in speech-first assistants that must interpret spoken queries and produce visually grounded decisions. Yet it remains unclear whether semantically equivalent queries yield consistent judgments across modality (text vs. speech) and language (English vs. Arabic). We introduce a speech-augmented visually grounded contrastive triplet benchmark spanning 10,150 culturally grounded images from 18 MENA countries, where each image is paired with one supported statement and two plausible but unsupported alternatives. We define contrastive instability as the conditional rate at which a model fails to resolve all statements within a triplet, isolating fragmented reasoning from complete failure. Evaluating recent multimodal models under text and speech in English and Arabic, we find that modality and language shifts introduce substantial triplet-level inconsistencies that are not fully captured by aggregate accuracy, with speech amplifying partial failures. We make the benchmark publicly available to the community.
articles.titleCn: 开口说出来，读起来不同：多模态模型中的跨模态不稳定性
articles.abstractCn: 多模态基础模型越来越多地应用于以语音为先的助手，这些助手需要解释语音查询并做出与视觉相关的决策。然而，语义等价的查询是否能在不同模态（文本与语音）和不同语言（英语与阿拉伯语）中产生一致判断仍不明确。我们引入了一个语音增强型视觉相关对比三元组基准，涵盖来自18个中东和北非国家的10,150张具有文化背景的图像，每张图像都配有一句支持性陈述和两句合理但不支持性陈述。我们将对比不稳定性定义为模型在三元组内无法解决所有陈述的条件比率，从而将碎片化推理与完全失败区分开来。在英语和阿拉伯语文本和语音下评估最新的多模态模型后，我们发现模态和语言的转换引入了三元组层面的显著不一致性，这些不一致性无法完全通过总体准确率来捕捉，且语音放大了部分失败。我们将该基准向社区公开。

articles.title: TwinKV: A Composable Repair Pass for KV Cache Eviction via Pairwise Key Redundancy
articles.abstract: Long-context inference is bottlenecked by the memory footprint of the key-value (KV) cache, especially for small models under tight resource budgets. Existing KV cache eviction methods score tokens using the model's attention distribution or, in attention-free variants, each key's distance from a global reference point. Using a controlled leave-one-out probe, we find that attention magnitude is unrelated to a token's causal contribution to the answer (Spearman $ρ=-0.004$), challenging the premise behind dominant eviction methods. We introduce TwinKV, a training-free, attention-free redundancy signal that detects whether a token's key has a near-duplicate elsewhere in context. Rather than replacing existing policies, TwinKV acts as a composable repair pass: given a policy's fixed retained set, it identifies evicted tokens with no surviving duplicate (\emph{orphans}) and retained tokens whose information is duplicated elsewhere (\emph{redundant donors}), then swaps them while preserving the original budget and scoring rule. We compose TwinKV with four recent eviction policies across LongBench, LooGLE, RULER, and a short-context MMLU-Pro no-harm control at compression ratios ${0.3,0.5,0.7}$. On Qwen3-4B, TwinKV improves a majority of configurations for two policies, is near-even for a third, and helps only a minority for a fourth adaptive baseline already near a performance ceiling; gains across the three non-ceiling policies are smallest at the loosest ratio. On RULER with Llama-3.2-1B, however, that fourth policy improves in every evaluated cell because its Alone score leaves substantial room to improve. More broadly, Llama-3.2-1B shows a smaller average LongBench gain but a higher fraction of improved cells on LongBench and LooGLE than Qwen3-4B, plus a clean RULER win. We also identify few-shot classification exemplars as a task structure where TwinKV does not help on either model.
articles.titleCn: TwinKV：一种通过成对键冗余实现KV缓存驱逐的可组合修复过程
articles.abstractCn: 长上下文推理受限于键值（KV）缓存的内存占用，尤其是在资源预算紧张时对小型模型的影响尤为显著。现有的KV缓存驱逐方法通过模型的注意力分布或无注意力变体中每个键与全局参考点的距离来评分令牌。通过使用受控的留一探测，我们发现注意力幅度与令牌对答案的因果贡献无关（Spearman $ρ=-0.004$），挑战了主流驱逐方法背后的前提。我们引入了TwinKV，这是一种无需训练、无注意力的冗余信号，用于检测令牌的键在上下文中其他位置是否存在近似重复。TwinKV并非取代现有策略，而是作为一种可组合的修复过程：给定策略的固定保留集，它识别被驱逐且无存活重复的令牌（孤儿）以及信息在其他地方被重复保留的令牌（冗余供体），然后交换它们，同时保持原始预算和评分规则。我们将TwinKV与LongBench、LooGLE、RULER以及一个短上下文MMLU-Pro无危害控制策略组合，压缩率分别为${0.3,0.5,0.7}$。在Qwen3-4B上，TwinKV改进了两种策略的大多数配置，对第三种策略近乎持平，对第四种自适应基线（已接近性能上限）仅帮助少数情况；在三个非上限策略中，最宽松压缩率下的增益最小。然而，在RULER与Llama-3.2-1B上，第四种策略在所有评估单元中均有所改进，因为其Alone分数仍有较大提升空间。更广泛地看，Llama-3.2-1B在LongBench和LooGLE上的平均增益较小，但改进单元比例更高，并在RULER中取得干净胜利。我们还发现，少样本分类任务结构是TwinKV在两种模型上均无帮助的领域。

articles.title: Cross-Lingual Alignment Without Joint Training: Do Monolingual Language Models Converge on Universal Representations?
articles.abstract: Cross-lingual alignment in multilingual language models is typically attributed to joint training: shared parameters, mixed-language batches, or explicit alignment objectives. We ask whether monolingual models trained on non-parallel data learn alignable representations without joint training. By testing on strictly monolingual language models, such as the Goldfish model families and independently developed models from different research labs, we find three results. Correlation: these models develop alignable representational geometry across layers, with alignment strengthening as data scale, model scale, or linguistic proximity increases. Construction: a single Procrustes rotation fit on parallel sentences maps hidden states between models. Causation: the same rotation transfers functional content; patching a rotated English residual into a German model on a factual cloze flips the prediction to the donor's capital in most cases. We confirm that cross-lingual alignment can emerge from the structure of language and the information it carries rather than from joint training, and this points to practical future directions including model stitching, merging, and modular multilingual systems built from monolingual components.
articles.titleCn: 跨语言对齐无需联合训练：单语语言模型是否收敛于通用表示？
articles.abstractCn: 多语言模型中的跨语言对齐通常归因于联合训练：共享参数、混合语言批次或显式对齐目标。我们探究单语模型在非平行数据上训练时，是否能在无联合训练的情况下学习到可对齐的表示。通过对严格单语的语言模型进行测试，例如Goldfish模型系列和不同研究实验室独立开发的模型，我们发现了三个结果。相关性：这些模型在各个层级上发展出可对齐的表示几何结构，随着数据规模、模型规模或语言亲缘性的增加，对齐效果增强。构造性：对齐平行句子进行单次Procrustes旋转拟合，可以映射模型间的隐藏状态。因果性：相同的旋转能转移功能内容；将旋转后的英语残差块修补到德语模型上，在事实性完形填空中，大多数情况下预测结果会切换到供体模型的资本。我们证实跨语言对齐可以源于语言结构和其携带的信息，而非联合训练，这为未来的实际方向提供了启示，包括模型拼接、合并以及由单语组件构建的模块化多语言系统。

articles.title: DocTalkBN: A Novel Dataset of Expert Telemedicine Conversations in Bengali
articles.abstract: Reliable medical conversational AI requires authentic expert--patient interaction data, yet such datasets remain scarce, especially for low-resource languages such as Bengali. We present DocTalkBN, a large-scale multimodal dataset of real-world expert telemedicine conversations in Bengali, collected from nationally broadcast telemedicine programs featuring board-certified physicians. DocTalkBN contains 557.63 hours of paired audio and text, 1,515 multi-turn patient calls, 10,274 host--doctor question--answer exchanges, totaling 1.7M tokens, spanning 26 medical specialties. Unlike prior resources derived from medical forums, written health content, or synthetic data, our dataset preserves the spontaneity, contextual richness, and spoken characteristics of authentic medical interactions in a low-resource setting. To support benchmark-driven research, we further construct three downstream tasks from the corpus, medical triage classification, advice safety evaluation, and medical named entity recognition, and benchmark a diverse set of large language models and encoder-based baselines. Our results show that DocTalkBN is a practically useful resource, particularly for clinically grounded reasoning tasks. We release this resource to facilitate future research on reliable medical NLP and safer, more culturally grounded healthcare systems for low-resource languages. Our source codes and dataset are publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/doctalk.
articles.titleCn: DocTalkBN：一个孟加拉语专家远程医疗对话的新数据集
articles.abstractCn: 可靠的医疗对话式人工智能需要真实的专家-患者交互数据，但此类数据集仍然稀缺，尤其是在孟加拉语等低资源语言中。我们提出了DocTalkBN，这是一个大规模多模态数据集，包含了孟加拉语现实世界远程医疗对话，数据来源于国家广播的远程医疗节目，节目由认证医师主持。DocTalkBN包含557.63小时配对的音频和文本，1,515个多轮患者呼叫，10,274个主持人与医生问答交互，总计1.7M个token，涵盖26个医学专科。与从医疗论坛、书面健康内容或合成数据中获取的先前资源不同，我们的数据集保留了低资源环境下真实医疗交互的即时性、语境丰富性和口语特征。为了支持基于基准的研究，我们从语料库中构建了三个下游任务：医疗分诊分类、建议安全评估和医疗命名实体识别，并基准测试了多种大型语言模型和基于编码器的基础模型。我们的结果表明，DocTalkBN是一个实用的资源，尤其适用于基于临床推理的任务。我们发布此资源以促进对可靠医疗NLP以及低资源语言更安全、更具文化基础医疗系统的未来研究。我们的源代码和数据集公开发布在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/doctalk。

articles.title: Unifying Detection and Adaptation in Task-Free Continual Learning
articles.abstract: To mitigate catastrophic forgetting in downstream continual learning (CL) for large language models (LLMs), existing methods typically constrain parameter updates or introduce task-specific adaptation modules. However, these methods often rely on explicit task boundaries during training, limiting their applicability to realistic task-free scenarios. In this paper, we propose a \textbf{Fi}sher-guided \textbf{uni}fied (\textbf{FiUni}) framework for batch-level task detection and parameter-efficient continual adaptation. FiUni is motivated by a key observation about the Fisher information matrix (FIM) of pre-trained models: the orthogonality among the principal subspaces of its Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature (K-FAC) approximation, estimated from a small number of downstream task samples, can reflect the similarity between different tasks. Based on this observation, FiUni constructs FIM-derived frozen subspaces to guide low-rank adaptation (LoRA), while matching the Fisher principal subspace of each incoming batch window with historical subspaces. This enables FiUni to adaptively determine whether to reuse existing knowledge, expand a related subspace, or create a new subspace, dynamically balancing knowledge sharing and task isolation. Experiments show that FiUni can effectively infer latent batch-level task affiliations and achieve competitive performance against advanced task-aware CL methods with fewer trainable parameters.
articles.titleCn: 在无任务持续学习中统一检测与适应
articles.abstractCn: 为了缓解大型语言模型（LLMs）在下游持续学习（CL）中的灾难性遗忘问题，现有方法通常通过约束参数更新或引入特定任务的适应模块来处理。然而，这些方法往往依赖于训练过程中的显式任务边界，限制了它们在现实无任务场景中的适用性。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于Fisher信息矩阵（FIM）指导的统一（FiUni）框架，用于批级任务检测和参数高效的持续适应。FiUni的灵感来源于预训练模型FIM的一个关键观察：其Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature（K-FAC）近似的主子空间之间的正交性，通过从少量下游任务样本中估计得到，可以反映不同任务之间的相似性。基于这一观察，FiUni构建了FIM衍生冻结子空间来指导低秩适应（LoRA），同时将每个输入批窗口的Fisher主子空间与历史子空间进行匹配。这使得FiUni能够自适应地判断是否重用现有知识、扩展相关子空间或创建新子空间，动态平衡知识共享和任务隔离。实验表明，FiUni能够有效地推断潜在批级任务关联性，并在参数数量更少的情况下，与先进的任务感知CL方法取得具有竞争力的性能。

articles.title: Research Design Tracking and Assessment for the Social Sciences
articles.abstract: Reliable assessment of causal research designs in the social sciences is critical for evidence-based policy-making, yet has so far relied entirely on manual expert analysis. We introduce Automated Research Design Tracking and Assessment (ARDTrA), a task that involves detecting the research design used in a paper and assessing the quality of its application. We create an expert-annotated dataset of papers covering six families of counterfactual research designs and evaluate the task using a multi-turn RAG-based conversational pipeline. Across four retrieval strategies, four LLMs and six embedding models, we find that passage length is the main driver of performance, explaining 52-66% of the variance. A per-research-design analysis also shows that human and machine difficulty do not align: the designs that prove hardest for the system are not those on which expert annotators disagree most, pointing to two independent sources of task difficulty.
articles.comment: Paper accepted at EMNLP 2026 - Main Conference
articles.titleCn: 社会科学研究设计、追踪与评估
articles.abstractCn: 在社会科学领域，对因果研究设计的可靠评估对于循证政策制定至关重要，但目前完全依赖于人工专家分析。我们介绍了自动化研究设计追踪与评估（ARDTrA）任务，该任务涉及检测论文中使用的研究设计，并评估其应用质量。我们创建了一个包含六类反事实研究设计的专家标注论文数据集，并使用基于多轮对话的RAG（检索增强生成）流程评估该任务。在四种检索策略、四种大型语言模型（LLM）和六种嵌入模型下，我们发现文本长度是性能的主要驱动因素，解释了52-66%的方差。对每种研究设计的单独分析也表明，人类和机器的难度并不一致：系统证明最困难的设计并非专家标注者分歧最大的设计，这指向了任务难度的两个独立来源。

articles.title: Cascaded Batch Prompting
articles.abstract: Although batch prompting makes large language model inference more efficient by processing multiple instances simultaneously, it suffers from unpredictable downstream task performance. We propose cascaded batch prompting, a two-stage approach designed to resolve the unpredictability of conventional batch prompting by disentangling complex reasoning from symbol grounding. Experiments on multiple-choice question answering and natural language inference demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the standard single prompting baseline while achieving a speedup proportional to batch size, establishing a new state of the art on the Pareto frontier.
articles.titleCn: 级联批量提示
articles.abstractCn: 尽管批量提示通过同时处理多个实例提高了大型语言模型的推理效率，但它存在下游任务性能不可预测的问题。我们提出了级联批量提示，这是一种两阶段方法，旨在通过将复杂的推理与符号接地分离来消除传统批量提示的不确定性。在多项选择题回答和自然语言推理上的实验表明，所提出的方法在实现与批量大小成比例的加速的同时，优于标准的单提示基线，在帕累托前沿上确立了新的技术前沿。

articles.title: Reasoning about In-Context Samples for Machine-Translation
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can be trained to perform chain-of-thoughts reasoning in order to improve the reliability of their responses. In this work, we investigate how explicit reasoning can be leveraged for LLM-Based Machine Translation (MT) with in-context samples. We introduce a novel fragment-based reasoning framework in which the model first extracts parallel source-target fragments from retrieved similar exemplars, and uses these fragments as intermediate reasoning traces to produce the final translation. To train our model, we distill silver fragments and drafts from a large teacher model. Our experiments with the Qwen3 model family, over 6 languages, including up to 5 domains per language, demonstrate that fragment-based MT significantly outperforms alternative methods like standard k-shot or basic drafting.
articles.titleCn: 针对机器翻译的上下文样本推理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）可以通过训练进行思维链推理，以提高其响应的可靠性。在这项工作中，我们研究了如何利用显式推理来改进基于LLM的机器翻译（MT），并结合上下文样本。我们引入了一种基于片段的推理框架，其中模型首先从检索到的相似示例中提取平行源-目标片段，并使用这些片段作为中间推理轨迹来生成最终翻译。为了训练我们的模型，我们从大型教师模型中提取银色片段和草稿。我们的实验使用Qwen3模型系列，涵盖6种语言，每种语言最多涉及5个领域，证明了基于片段的MT显著优于标准k-shot或基本草稿等替代方法。

articles.title: Representing and Parsing Korean Constituency Structure at Different Levels of Granularity
articles.abstract: Korean constituency parsing raises a representational challenge because the terminal units of a phrase-structure tree do not straightforwardly correspond to simple surface words. Korean eojeols are morphologically complex spacing units, and existing constituency resources differ in how they represent eojeol-internal morphology and non-overt elements. This paper compares three constituency parsing representations derived from the Penn Korean Treebank: Morpheme+XPOS, Eojeol+XPOS, and Eojeol+UPOS. We construct these representations by removing null elements, aligning Penn Korean phrase structure with overt eojeol tokens, preserving Penn Korean phrase labels where possible, and varying the terminal and preterminal layers. We then evaluate canonical non-binary transition-based constituency parsers in top-down, in-order, and bottom-up orders under a shared modeling and evaluation setup. All experiments use gold terminal segmentation and gold preterminal labels and therefore evaluate constituency parsing conditioned on gold morphosyntactic annotation. Eojeol terminals yield shorter transition sequences, but Eojeol+UPOS parsing substantially underperforms the morphologically richer conditions. Eojeol+XPOS narrows this gap, while Morpheme+XPOS gives the strongest results even after its predictions are projected to the eojeol terminal domain. Under these gold-annotation conditions, the results show that fine-grained morphological and XPOS representations provide valuable evidence for the evaluated parsers. This empirical finding concerns the information available for parsing and does not by itself determine the linguistically preferable terminal domain. Independently, linguistic and resource-design considerations motivate eojeol as a stable and interpretable surface domain for phrase-structure annotation, with morpheme-level and XPOS information retained as aligned morphosyntactic evidence.
articles.titleCn: 在不同粒度级别上表示和解析韩语短语结构
articles.abstractCn: 韩语成分句分析提出了一个表示上的挑战，因为短语结构树的终端单元并不直接对应于简单的表层词。韩语 eojeol 是形态复杂的空间单元，现有的成分句资源在如何表示 eojeol 内部形态和非显性元素方面存在差异。本文比较了从宾夕法尼亚韩语树库衍生出的三种成分句分析表示：Morpheme+XPOS、Eojeol+XPOS 和 Eojeol+UPOS。我们通过移除空元素、将宾夕法尼亚韩语句法结构与显性 eojeol token 对齐、尽可能保留宾夕法尼亚韩语句法标签，并变化终端层和次终端层来构建这些表示。然后，在共享建模和评估设置下，以自上而下、中序和自下而上顺序评估经典的非二元转换式成分句分析器。所有实验均使用金标准终端分割和金标准次终端标签，因此评估的是基于金标准形态句法标注的条件成分句分析。Eojeol 终端产生更短的转换序列，但 Eojeol+UPOS 分析在形态更丰富的条件下表现大幅落后。Eojeol+XPOS 缩小了这一差距，而 Morpheme+XPOS 即使在预测被投影到 eojeol 终端域后仍取得了最佳结果。在这些金标注条件下，结果表明细粒度形态和 XPOS 表示为评估的分析器提供了有价值的证据。这一实证发现涉及解析可用信息，本身并不决定语言学上更优的终端域。独立于语言和资源设计考虑之外，eojeol 被视为一个稳定且可解释的表层域，用于短语结构标注，同时保留词素级和 XPOS 信息作为对齐的形态句法证据。

articles.title: ITL: Interpretable Document Alignment with Structured Reference Frameworks
articles.abstract: Measuring alignment between documents and structured reference frameworks requires identifying conceptual evidence distributed throughout the text and reporting it through measures that are quantitative, interpretable, and traceable. Many commonly used retrieval and classification approaches return either pairwise similarity scores or one or more class labels, whereas fewer methods provide concept-level scores that are directly traceable to the terminological evidence supporting them. We present \emph{Intelligent Target Locator} (ITL), a domain-agnostic and language-portable methodology that estimates the affinity between the textual units of a target document and the concepts defined in a \emph{Structured Reference Document} ($SRD$). From the $SRD$, ITL induces concept-specific terminological profiles built from independent terms, bigrams, trigrams, and co-occurrences. Each term is assigned an importance weight that combines concept membership, term-type specificity and inter-concept discriminability. The output is a textual-unit--concept affinity matrix that can be aggregated at different levels of granularity. We conduct an internal consistency assessment using the 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), evaluating each official goal statement against the $SRD$ induced from the same set of descriptors. Every statement reached its highest affinity with the corresponding concept, and the mean affinity across the remaining concepts stayed marginal relative to the mean reference affinity. This separation indicates that ITL distinguishes the conceptual profiles of the framework. ITL thus offers a general basis for quantifying document alignment with structured frameworks while keeping each result traceable to the terminological evidence that supports it.
articles.titleCn: ITL：基于结构化参考框架的可解释文档对齐
articles.abstractCn: 衡量文档与结构化参考框架之间的对齐性需要识别文本中分布的概念证据，并通过定量、可解释且可追溯的指标进行报告。许多常用的检索和分类方法返回成对相似度分数或一个或多个类别标签，而较少方法提供可直接追溯到支持其术语证据的概念级分数。我们提出 \emph{智能目标定位器}（ITL），这是一种领域无关且语言可移植的方法，用于估计目标文档的文本单元与 \emph{结构化参考文档}（$SRD$）中定义的概念之间的亲密度。从 $SRD$ 中，ITL 推导出由独立术语、双词组、三词组和共现构建的概念特定术语轮廓。每个术语被分配一个重要性权重，该权重结合了概念成员资格、术语类型特异性和概念间可区分性。输出是一个文本单元—概念亲密度矩阵，该矩阵可以在不同粒度级别上进行聚合。我们使用 17 个可持续发展目标（SDGs）进行内部一致性评估，将每个官方目标声明与从同一组描述符中推导出的 $SRD$ 进行评估。每个声明都达到了与其对应概念的最高亲密度，而其余概念的平均亲密度相对于平均参考亲密度保持边缘水平。这种区分表明 ITL 能够区分框架的概念轮廓。因此，ITL 为量化文档与结构化框架的对齐性提供了一个通用基础，同时确保每个结果都可追溯到支持其的术语证据。

articles.title: JudgeStealer: Extracting LLM Judging Capabilities across Evaluation Protocols
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) judges are increasingly used across various evaluation scenarios, making their judgment capabilities valuable intellectual property. However, black-box access exposes these capabilities to model extraction attacks. Existing extraction methods do not specifically target LLM judges and provide limited support for multiple evaluation protocols under restricted query budgets. In this study, we propose JUDGESTEALER, the first query-efficient model extraction framework for replicating judging capabilities across pointwise scoring, pairwise comparison, and listwise ranking protocols. JUDGESTEALER exploits the strong cross-protocol agreement to acquire pointwise scores and transform them into pairwise and listwise supervisions without additional victim queries. To capture informative judge patterns and improve query efficiency, JUDGESTEALER dynamically selects pointwise inputs based on semantic diversity, predictive uncertainty, and potential judge biases. It further applies score smoothing and multi-protocol review to preserve the ordinal structure of scores and mitigate catastrophic forgetting during surrogate adaptation. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art LLM-as-a-judge and reward models show that JUDGESTEALER consistently outperforms existing extraction baselines, achieving up to 73.3%, 87.0%, and 71.6% accuracy for pointwise, pairwise, and listwise evaluation, respectively. JUDGESTEALER also remains effective across different sur- rogate model scales, adaptation strategies, and reasoning settings. Moreover, JUDGESTEALER demonstrates robustness against representative extraction defenses.
articles.titleCn: JudgeStealer：跨评估协议提取大型语言模型的评判能力
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）评判器在多种评估场景中应用日益广泛，其评判能力已成为宝贵的知识产权。然而，黑盒访问方式使这些能力暴露于模型提取攻击之下。现有的提取方法并未专门针对LLM评判器，且在受限查询预算下对多种评估协议的支持有限。在本研究中，我们提出了JUDGESTEALER，这是首个用于在点式评分、两两比较和列表式排序协议中复制评判能力的查询高效模型提取框架。JUDGESTEALER利用强跨协议一致性，在不增加受害者查询的情况下获取点式评分并将其转化为两两比较和列表式监督。为捕捉信息丰富的评判模式并提高查询效率，JUDGESTEALER根据语义多样性、预测不确定性和潜在的评判偏差动态选择点式输入。此外，它应用评分平滑和多协议审查来保留评分的序数结构，并在代理适应过程中减轻灾难性遗忘。在当前最先进的LLM作为评判器和奖励模型上的大量实验表明，JUDGESTEALER始终优于现有提取基线，在点式、两两比较和列表式评估中分别达到73.3%、87.0%和71.6%的准确率。JUDGESTEALER在不同代理模型规模、适应策略和推理设置下均保持有效。此外，JUDGESTEALER还表现出对代表性提取防御的鲁棒性。

articles.title: Terrain signatures in Welsh settlement names
articles.abstract: Landscapes are named, but whether names retain measurable environmental information beyond broad geographic structure is rarely tested. We analysed 3,757 Welsh settlements using a frozen, source-audited 24-element lexical framework, preregistered outcome-specific models and geographically structured validation. The central comparison contrasted 101 settlements carrying high-terrain elements (\textit{bryn} or \textit{mynydd}) with 139 carrying low-terrain elements (\textit{cwm} or \textit{pant}). High-terrain names occupied locations 24.4 m higher relative to their 2-km surroundings (95\% CI, 10.8--38.1 m; Holm-adjusted $p$ = 0.00137). The association remained positive across prespecified 1-, 2- and 5-km neighbourhood definitions and was reproduced using an independently produced elevation source (24.1 m; 95\% CI, 10.6--37.6 m). Adding terrain-name polarity to a non-lexical spatial and settlement baseline reduced geographically held-out mean squared error by 4.63\%, 6.22\% and 7.30\% under 10-, 25- and 50-km spatial blocking, respectively, although improvement varied among held-out regions. River-related names provided weaker, directionally consistent evidence, while the preregistered woodland model was non-estimable. Residual spatial structure, unresolved name language and the absence of independent external replication limit interpretation. Selected Welsh settlement-name categories therefore retain measurable information about present-day terrain within Wales, without establishing individual etymology, causal naming, historical environmental memory or transferability to other naming systems.
articles.titleCn: 威尔士定居点名称中的地形特征
articles.abstractCn: 地名被赋予名称，但名称是否在广义地理结构之外保留了可测量的环境信息，却很少得到检验。我们分析了3,757个威尔士定居点，采用一个冻结的、来源审核的24要素词汇框架，预先注册了结果特定的模型，并进行了地理结构化验证。核心比较对比了101个包含高地形元素（如“bryn”或“mynydd”）的定居点与139个包含低地形元素（如“cwm”或“pant”）的定居点。高地形名称所在位置比其2公里范围内的位置高出24.4米（95%置信区间，10.8--38.1米；Holm调整$p$ = 0.00137）。这种关联在预先指定的1公里、2公里和5公里邻域定义中仍然保持正值，并使用独立生成的海拔数据源得到了验证（24.1米；95%置信区间，10.6--37.6米）。在10公里、25公里和50公里空间块下，将地形名称极性添加到非词汇空间和定居点基线中，分别将地理保留数据的均方误差降低了4.63%、6.22%和7.30%，尽管改进程度在不同保留区域有所不同。与河流相关的名称提供了较弱但方向一致的证据，而预先注册的林地模型不可估计。残留的空间结构、未解决的地名语言以及缺乏独立外部验证限制了解释。因此，选定的威尔士定居点名称类别保留了关于威尔士现代地形可测量的信息，但并未确定个体词源、因果命名、历史环境记忆或可迁移性到其他命名系统。

articles.title: Squeezing More from Limited Data with Recursive Transformers
articles.abstract: Pre-training under limited data requires a different view of scaling than web-scale language modeling. With a fixed data budget but relatively abundant compute, increasing parameter count helps only up to an optimal scale; beyond that point, models overfit and generalization worsens. We study this behavior across 10M-100M word pre-training budgets, two corpora, and multiple downstream evaluations, and find that optimal size depends strongly on both the data budget and the downstream target. We argue that standard Transformers scale down poorly to this setting, because embeddings consume a large fraction of the parameter budget and per-token computation is tied to representational capacity. To address this coupling, we study recursive Transformers, reusing a shared block across depth to scale compute, together with factorized embeddings to reduce vocabulary-map parameters. We train three recursive models and find that they outperform standard Transformers at 10M and 100M words, while remaining competitive with BabyLM Challenge 2025 winners.
articles.titleCn: 利用递归Transformer从有限数据中获取更多价值
articles.abstractCn: 在数据有限的情况下进行预训练，需要不同于大规模语言模型的规模扩展视角。在固定的数据预算但相对充足的计算资源下，增加参数数量只能帮助到最优规模；超过这一点，模型会过拟合，泛化能力会下降。我们研究了在1000万-1亿词预训练预算、两个语料库和多个下游评估中的这种行为，发现最优规模强烈依赖于数据预算和下游目标。我们认为标准Transformer模型在这种设置下扩展效果不佳，因为嵌入占用了大量参数预算，且每个词的计算量与表示能力绑定。为解决这种耦合问题，我们研究了递归Transformer，通过在深度中复用一个共享模块来扩展计算量，并结合分解嵌入来减少词汇映射参数。我们训练了三个递归模型，发现它们在1000万和1亿词时优于标准Transformer，同时与BabyLM Challenge 2025的优胜者保持竞争力。

articles.title: TEMPLAR Wales: A georeferenced environmental and toponymic dataset of Welsh settlements
articles.abstract: Place names provide persistent records of how landscapes have been described and organised, but their quantitative reuse requires explicit separation between mapped places, lexical annotations and environmental measurements. TEMPLAR Wales is a georeferenced environmental-toponymy dataset comprising 3,757 settlement records across Wales. The resource links a reproducible settlement frame to deterministic lexical screening and settlement-level environmental attributes through stable identifiers. It contains 1,350 lexical detections across 1,294 settlements, generated from a frozen registry of 24 Welsh place-name elements, while retaining exact- and prefix-token matches and their provenance separately. Environmental attributes describe river and coastal proximity, elevation and local terrain context at multiple spatial scales, land cover and neighbourhood woody cover, with parallel terrain measurements derived from independent elevation products. The dataset is distributed as four relational tables accompanied by a field-level data dictionary, source-provenance register and licensing metadata. Technical validation confirms relational integrity, deterministic lexical reconstruction, documented environmental coverage, strong agreement between independent terrain sources and reproducible reconstruction of the frozen release. TEMPLAR Wales provides a reusable foundation for research in toponymy, linguistic geography, historical and environmental landscape studies, GIS and spatial data analysis without treating computational lexical detections as verified etymologies or contemporary environmental measurements as historical landscape reconstructions.
articles.titleCn: 威尔士骑士团：威尔士定居点的地理参考环境与地名数据集
articles.abstractCn: 地名提供了关于景观如何被描述和组织的持久记录，但对其定量重用需要将地图上的地点、词汇注释和环境测量明确区分。TEMPLAR Wales是一个地理参考的环境专名学数据集，涵盖了威尔士地区3,757个定居点记录。该资源通过稳定标识符将可重复的定居点框架与确定性词汇筛选和定居点级环境属性相链接。它包含1,294个定居点中的1,350个词汇检测，这些检测来自一个包含24个威尔士地名元素的冻结注册表，同时分别保留精确匹配和前缀标记匹配及其来源。环境属性描述了河流和海岸的邻近性、海拔高度和局部地形背景，以及多个空间尺度的土地覆盖和邻近林冠覆盖，并从独立的海拔产品中导出平行地形测量。该数据集以四个关系表的形式分发，并附带字段级数据词典、来源溯源注册表和许可元数据。技术验证确认了关系完整性、确定性词汇重建、记录的环境覆盖范围、独立地形来源之间的高度一致性，以及冻结发布的可重复重建。TEMPLAR Wales为地名学、语言地理学、历史和环境景观研究、GIS和空间数据分析提供了可重复使用的基础，而不将计算词汇检测视为已验证的词源，也不将当代环境测量视为历史景观重建。

articles.title: Scaling Model-Generated Distillation Data Can Make Latent Teacher Traits More Recoverable
articles.abstract: Scaling model-generated data is usually viewed as improving distillation: more examples should increase coverage, reduce noise, and produce stronger students. We show a second effect: larger datasets can make subtle teacher-specific signals easier to detect in the trained student, even when examples are off-task and never mention the trait. In a controlled setup inspired by subliminal learning, a teacher induced to express a target trait generates restricted off-task data, such as number-only completions. Students trained on different amounts of independent off-task data are evaluated in a separate domain, with matched no-trait controls isolating target-specific transfer. Our main finding is that larger independent datasets make the teacher's induced trait stand out more clearly in the student's later behavior. Other plausible traits may also strengthen with scale, but the target usually grows more. When the small-scale student already favors the target, scaling mainly amplifies that behavior; when it favors a related or salient alternative, more data can shift behavior toward the intended trait. Analyses of learned LoRA updates show a parallel trend. These effects appear across model families, trait types, multi-trait settings, and cross-model transfer. Our results suggest that scaling generated distillation data should be paired with trait-aware curation and evaluation, even when the data appears off-task or benign.
articles.titleCn: 通过扩展模型生成的蒸馏数据可以使潜在导师特征更易恢复
articles.abstractCn: 扩展模型生成的数据通常被视为改进蒸馏：更多的示例应该增加覆盖率、减少噪声，并产生更强的学生模型。我们展示了一种第二种效应：更大的数据集即使在示例与任务无关且从未提及该特征的情况下，也能使训练的学生模型更容易检测到细微的教师特定信号。在一个受潜意识学习启发的受控设置中，被诱导表达目标特征的教师生成受限的非任务数据，例如仅包含数字的补全。在不同数量的独立非任务数据上训练的学生模型在单独的领域中进行评估，匹配的无特征控制隔离了目标特定迁移。我们的主要发现是，更大的独立数据集使教师诱导的特征在学生后续行为中更加突出。其他合理的特征也可能随着规模增强，但目标特征通常增长更多。当小规模学生已经倾向于目标特征时，扩展主要放大该行为；当它倾向于相关或显著的替代特征时，更多数据可以将行为转向预期的特征。对学习到的LoRA更新的分析显示出平行趋势。这些效应在模型家族、特征类型、多特征设置和跨模型迁移中均出现。我们的结果表明，扩展生成的蒸馏数据应与特征感知的策展和评估相结合，即使数据看似与任务无关或无害。

articles.title: From Atomic to Agentic: Towards Interpretable Evaluation of LLMs' Agentic Mathematical Capabilities
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are evolving from performing end-to-end mathematical reasoning to integrating agentic intelligence. However, most existing math benchmarks evaluate only final answers. This outcome-oriented evaluation provides limited diagnostic value for identifying process-level failures or rigorous logic, failing to guide the transformation of LLMs into robust agents. To bridge this gap, we present a process-level benchmark designed to evaluate the inherent agentic mathematical reasoning abilities of LLMs. Our framework aligns problem-solving agentic behaviors with a structured taxonomy of reusable mathematical atomic capabilities. We design a comprehensive suite of planning, action, and feedback tasks across both textual and multimodal contexts, supported by an automated pipeline that synthesizes high-quality trajectories and produces fine-grained annotations via controlled LLM rewriting. Experiments reveal that models with similar end-to-end accuracy can exhibit markedly different agentic capability profiles. This demonstrates that process-level evaluation is crucial for interpreting the true potential of LLMs and guiding the development of next-generation mathematical agents.
articles.titleCn: 从原子到自主：迈向对大型语言模型自主数学能力的可解释评估
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正从执行端到端的数学推理发展到集成代理智能。然而，大多数现有的数学基准测试仅评估最终答案。这种结果导向的评估对于识别过程层面的失败或严谨逻辑的有限诊断价值，无法指导LLMs向鲁棒代理的转型。为弥补这一差距，我们提出一个过程层面的基准测试，旨在评估LLMs固有的代理式数学推理能力。我们的框架将问题解决的代理行为与可重用的数学原子能力结构化分类法相结合。我们设计了一套涵盖文本和多模态环境的规划、行动和反馈任务，并辅以自动化流程，通过受控的LLM重写合成高质量轨迹，生成细粒度标注。实验表明，具有相似端到端准确度的模型可能表现出截然不同的代理能力配置。这表明过程层面的评估对于解读LLMs的真实潜力以及指导下一代数学代理的发展至关重要。

articles.title: KinyaEmbed: Contrastive Sentence Embeddings for Kinyarwanda via Multi-Stage Curriculum Training
articles.abstract: We present KinyaEmbed, the first dedicated sentence embedding model for Kinyarwanda, a morphologically rich Bantu language spoken by over 12 million people in Rwanda. Existing multilingual embedding models such as LaBSE, mE5-large, and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large perform poorly on Kinyarwanda due to severe under-representation in their pre-training corpora. KinyaEmbed is built on KinyaBERT-large and trained via a four-stage curriculum using MultipleNegativesRankingLoss (MNRL): Stage 1 leverages ~18,000 paraphrase pairs from the Official Gazette of Rwanda with three temperature scales; Stage 2 fine-tunes on 715 NLLB-translated MNLI triplets for entailment structure; Stage 3 aligns representations using English-Kinyarwanda OPUS-100 translation pairs; Stage 4 refines with 2,936 high-quality pairs filtered from KinyaCOMET at quality threshold 0.8. We evaluate on SemRel2024-rw and introduce Wiki-RW-STS, a new contamination-free Kinyarwanda STS benchmark of 300 pairs derived from Kinyarwanda Wikipedia. A seven-checkpoint ensemble (all5+23A*2, with the final stage double-weighted) achieves Spearman \r{ho}=0.7298 on SemRel2024-rw, surpassing mE5-large by 20.9% and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large by 41.0%. KinyaEmbed also achieves the best document clustering silhouette score (0.2146) across all evaluated models. All checkpoints, the KinyaCOMET filtered pairs, and the Wiki-RW-STS benchmark are publicly available.
articles.titleCn: KinyaEmbed：用于基尼亚语的对比句嵌入，通过多阶段课程训练实现
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了KinyaEmbed，这是首个专门针对基尼亚隆达语开发的单语句子嵌入模型。基尼亚隆达语是一种形态丰富的班图语，在卢旺达有超过1200万人使用。由于现有多语言嵌入模型如LaBSE、mE5-large和OpenAI text-embedding-3-large在预训练语料库中对基尼亚隆达语严重欠代表，它们在该语言上的表现不佳。KinyaEmbed基于KinyaBERT-large构建，并通过四阶段课程使用MultipleNegativesRankingLoss（MNRL）进行训练：第一阶段利用卢旺达官方公报中的约18,000个释义对，采用三种温度尺度；第二阶段在715个NLLB翻译的MNLI三元组上进行蕴含结构微调；第三阶段使用英语-基尼亚隆达语OPUS-100翻译对对齐表示；第四阶段使用从KinyaCOMET中筛选出的2,936个高质量对（质量阈值为0.8）进行精炼。我们在SemRel2024-rw上进行了评估，并引入了Wiki-RW-STS，这是一个无污染的基尼亚隆达语跨语言句子相似度（STS）基准，包含300对从基尼亚隆达语维基百科衍生而来的数据。一个包含七个检查点的集成模型（all5+23A*2，最终阶段双权重）在SemRel2024-rw上达到了Spearman \r{ho}=0.7298，比mE5-large高20.9%，比OpenAI text-embedding-3-large高41.0%。KinyaEmbed还获得了所有评估模型中最佳的文档聚类轮廓系数（0.2146）。所有检查点、KinyaCOMET筛选的对以及Wiki-RW-STS基准均已公开。

articles.title: Mapping Written Words to Spoken Words in a Different Language Using Only Visual Grounding
articles.abstract: In many low-resource settings, even just eliciting speech for data collection is difficult. One promising approach has been to ask speakers to describe images. But how do we build models from such visually grounded speech data? Given a dataset of images with Hindi spoken captions, we consider how we can map a written English keyword to spoken realisations of that word in Hindi. Previous work trained end-to-end multimodal neural models. Instead, we explore a simpler alignment-based approach built on self-supervised speech representations. Written English tags are automatically obtained from images using off-the-shelf image captioning systems. Hindi utterances associated with the same keyword are then aligned (using self-supervised features), and alignment evidence is aggregated to identify recurring speech segments corresponding to the target word. Experiments evaluating keyword spotting and localization show that our alignment-based approach outperforms a previous attention-based neural model. We also show the benefit of incorporating negative examples during alignment. Our work demonstrates that cross-lingual word-to-speech mappings can be learned directly from visual grounding without transcriptions or explicit model training.
