articles.titleCn: 仅通过视觉基础在不同语言中将书面文字映射到口语
articles.abstractCn: 在许多低资源环境中，仅为了数据收集而获取语音本身就十分困难。一种有前景的方法是要求说话者描述图像。但我们如何从这种基于视觉的语音数据中构建模型呢？给定一个带有印地语语音描述的图像数据集，我们考虑如何将书面英语关键词映射到该词在印地语中的语音实现。以往的研究训练了端到端的多模态神经网络模型。相反，我们探索了一种基于对齐的更简单的方法，该方法基于自监督语音表示。书面英语标签通过现成的图像描述系统自动从图像中获取。然后，与相同关键词相关的印地语语句被对齐（使用自监督特征），并对齐证据进行聚合，以识别与目标词对应的重复语音片段。评估关键词识别和定位的实验表明，我们的基于对齐的方法优于以往基于注意力的神经网络模型。我们还展示了在对齐过程中加入负例的好处。我们的研究表明，跨语言的词到语音映射可以直接从视觉基础中学习，而无需转录或显式模型训练。

articles.title: TabuLM: Morphology-Aware Tabular Pre-training for Low-Resource Languages
articles.abstract: We present TabuLM, the first language model pre-trained on Kinyarwanda tabular data. Kinyarwanda is a morphologically rich Bantu language spoken by over 12 million people in Rwanda, yet lacks any dedicated tabular representation learning resource. TabuLM extends KinyaBERT-large, a two-tier morphological transformer, with additive row, column, and cell-type embeddings and a learned table-structure attention bias that sharpens same-row and same-column attention. Pre-training uses two new objectives: Masked Cell Recovery (MCR), which masks entire cells and forces reconstruction from row and column context, and Column Type Prediction (CTP), which predicts column semantic types from observed cell values. We pre-train on 172 Rwandan government tables (~35,000 cells) from NISR, RAB, REB, and MoH open-data portals, and introduce TabQA-kin, the first native Kinyarwanda table question-answering benchmark comprising 526 QA pairs across 31 tables and four question types. TabuLM achieves 62.0% exact match on TabQA-kin, outperforming KinyaBERT-large by 5.7 EM points and all multilingual baselines (mBERT 49.3%, XLM-R 50.0%) by 11.7-12.7 points. Analysis shows that structural table embeddings are most decisive for comparison and lookup questions, while morphological awareness provides complementary gains. Our code, data, and pre-trained checkpoint are publicly available.
articles.titleCn: TabuLM：面向低资源语言的形态感知表格预训练
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了TabuLM，这是首个在基尼亚隆达语表格数据上进行预训练的语言模型。基尼亚隆达语是一种形态丰富的班图语，在卢旺达有超过1200万人使用，但目前缺乏任何专门的表格表示学习资源。TabuLM通过添加行、列和单元格类型嵌入，以及一个学习到的表格结构注意力偏差来扩展KinyaBERT-large（一个双层形态Transformer），该偏差增强了同行和同列的注意力。预训练使用两个新的目标：掩码单元格恢复（MCR），它掩码整个单元格并迫使从行和列上下文中重建，以及列类型预测（CTP），它根据观察到的单元格值预测列的语义类型。我们在来自NISR、RAB、REB和MoH开放数据门户的172个卢旺达政府表格（约35,000个单元格）上进行预训练，并引入了TabQA-kin，这是首个本土基尼亚隆达语表格问答基准，包含31个表格和四种问题类型中的526个问答对。TabuLM在TabQA-kin上实现了62.0%的精确匹配，比KinyaBERT-large高5.7个EM分，比所有多语言基线（mBERT 49.3%，XLM-R 50.0%）高11.7-12.7分。分析表明，结构表格嵌入对比较和查找问题最为关键，而形态意识提供了补充增益。我们的代码、数据和预训练检查点都是公开可用的。

articles.title: AraMS-28k: The Largest Publicly Released Line-Level Dataset of Historical Arabic Manuscripts with Margin and Insertion-Anchor Annotations
articles.abstract: We introduce AraMS-28k, the largest publicly released line-level dataset of genuine historical Arabic manuscripts, comprising 14 books, 3,043 pages, and 28,600 annotated text lines (27,971 main-text, 629 margin). Thirteen books are hand-copied manuscripts spanning three script traditions -- Naskh, Ruq'ah, and Maghrebi -- and one is a lithographed printed edition included to broaden format diversity. Each line is labelled as main-text or margin, and margin lines that have an unambiguous attachment point in the main text are further annotated with an insertion anchor, recovering the manuscript's true non-linear reading order at line-level granularity -- to our knowledge the first such annotation released for a historical Arabic manuscript corpus. Because reference transcriptions are fully vocalised while manuscript hands are typically undiacritised, we release both the raw diacritised transcription and a diacritic-normalised counterpart for every line. The dataset was constructed with RefLAM, a reference-grounded annotation pipeline that aligns multimodal-LLM OCR against independently sourced clean transcriptions and routes every line through human review, combining automatic verification with expert oversight. We describe the construction and quality-control process, present the annotation schema, report dataset statistics at both the corpus and per-book level, and provide baseline HTR results using Kraken and HATFormer, including a cross-script generalisation gradient from in-distribution pages to fully unseen books. AraMS-28k is released with page images, line-level annotations, and fixed train/val/test splits under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 to support reproducible research on Arabic manuscript recognition, layout analysis, and reading-order recovery.

articles.titleCn: AraMS-28k：带有边注和插入锚注的历史阿拉伯手稿最大公开行级数据集
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了AraMS-28k，这是目前最大公开发布的真实历史阿拉伯手稿逐行级数据集，包含14本书籍、3,043页和28,600条标注文本行（27,971条正文，629条页边空白）。其中13本书是跨越三种书写传统——纳斯克体、鲁卡体和马格里布体——的手抄本，另一本是石印版印刷书籍，旨在增加格式多样性。每行被标注为正文或页边空白，且具有明确依附点的页边空白行进一步标注了插入锚点，从而在行级粒度上恢复手稿的真实非线性阅读顺序——据我们所知，这是首次为历史阿拉伯手稿语料库发布此类标注。由于参考转录完全注音，而手稿文本通常未注音，我们为每行同时发布了原始注音转录和注音标准化版本。该数据集使用RefLAM构建，RefLAM是一种基于参考的标注流程，将多模态-LLM OCR与独立来源的清洁转录进行对齐，并将每行通过人工审核，结合自动验证与专家监督。我们描述了构建和质量控制流程，展示了标注模式，报告了语料库和每本书籍级别的数据集统计信息，并提供了使用Kraken和HATFormer的基线HTR结果，包括从分布内页面到完全未见过的书籍的跨书写体泛化梯度。AraMS-28k在CC BY-NC-SA 4.0许可下发布，包含页面图像、逐行级标注和固定的训练/验证/测试分割，以支持阿拉伯手稿识别、布局分析和阅读顺序恢复的可重复性研究。

articles.title: Planting a Latent Variable in Natural-Looking Text: a More Realistic Test of Belief States in LLMs and Their Link to Concept Geometry
articles.abstract: LLMs are thought to track "belief states," i.e., running probability distributions over the latent variables that govern language (Shai et al., 2024; Sarfati et al., 2026), but so far this has only been comprehensively demonstrated on toy synthetic data and in a few isolated case studies. It has also never been empirically connected to the geometry of LLM features (the concepts interpretability finds in model activations). In this work, we plant a controllable latent variable inside natural-looking text. An LLM teacher writes ordinary text while we "subliminally" steer it along one of K = 8 unrelated sparse autoencoder directions at each token, with the active directions following a ring-shaped Markov chain. A small transformer model trained on this corpus does indeed track the Bayesian posterior belief about our planted latent variable. Moreover, it also arranges the 8 states themselves on a ring, in the exact order of the Markov chain, which is supporting evidence that a concept's geometry can be formed by the statistical dynamics of the latent variable behind it.
articles.titleCn: 在自然文本中植入潜在变量：对大型语言模型信念状态的更真实测试及其与概念几何的联系
articles.abstractCn: 人们认为大型语言模型（LLMs）能够追踪“信念状态”，即对控制语言的潜在变量运行的概率分布（Shai等人，2024；Sarfati等人，2026），但目前这仅在玩具合成数据和少数孤立案例研究中得到了全面验证。此外，它从未与LLM特征的几何结构（即模型激活中可解释性发现的概念）建立实证联系。在这项工作中，我们在自然文本中植入了一个可控的潜在变量。一个LLM教师撰写普通文本，而我们则“潜意识地”引导它在每个词元沿着K=8个不相关的稀疏自编码器方向之一移动，其中活跃方向遵循环形马尔可夫链。一个在语料库上训练的小型Transformer模型确实追踪了我们植入的潜在变量的贝叶斯后验信念。此外，它还按照马尔可夫链的精确顺序将这8个状态排列在环形上，这为“概念”的几何结构可以由其背后的潜在变量的统计动力学形成提供了支持证据。

articles.title: C-Unseen: Weak Signal Detection in Dynamic Temporal Knowledge Graphs via LLM Reasoning
articles.abstract: Weak signals are early, low-visibility indicators that precede significant changes before those changes become established. Existing detection methods, based on keyword frequency, topic modeling, or untyped graph topology, fail to capture the semantic and relational structure through which such signals manifest. In this paper, we propose C-Unseen, a self-interpretable framework for weak signal detection in Dynamic Temporal Knowledge Graphs (DTKGs). We define a weak signal as a rare, semantically coherent subgraph that proliferates across consecutive TKG snapshots. The framework operates through two modules: a Rare Subgraphs Extractor, in which an LLM identifies subgraphs whose content is in tension with the dominant snapshot narrative via chain-of-thought reasoning, and a Weak Signal Alerter, in which the persistence of these rare subgraphs is tracked across time steps to isolate true weak signals. Experimental results demonstrate that C-Unseen outperforms keyword-, topic-, and graph-based baselines.

articles.titleCn: C-Unseen：基于LLM推理的动态时序知识图谱弱信号检测
articles.abstractCn: 微弱信号是重大变化发生前出现的早期、低可见度指标，这些变化在形成稳定之前难以察觉。现有的检测方法，基于关键词频率、主题模型或无类型图拓扑，无法捕捉这些信号所呈现的语义和关系结构。在本文中，我们提出了C-Unseen框架，用于动态时序知识图谱（DTKGs）中的微弱信号检测。我们将微弱信号定义为在连续的TKG快照中不断扩散的罕见、语义连贯的子图。该框架通过两个模块运行：一个罕见子图提取器，其中大型语言模型（LLM）通过思维链推理识别内容与主导快照叙事相冲突的子图；一个微弱信号警报器，其中追踪这些罕见子图随时间步长的持续性，以分离出真正的微弱信号。实验结果表明，C-Unseen在基于关键词、主题和图的方法的基线中表现更优。

articles.title: Evaluating Confidence-Gated Retrieval with Matched Trajectory Replay
articles.abstract: Interactive language-model agents use confidence signals to decide whether to answer immediately, retrieve additional evidence (from memory or external knowledge), or defer. Yet confidence is usually evaluated in isolation, without measuring the trajectory-level consequences of the actions it triggers. We propose matched trajectory replay, a controlled protocol for comparing confidence-to-action mappings. The protocol holds candidate answer states, evidence points, budgets, and action costs fixed. We use it to compare raw verbalized confidence with post-hoc isotonic calibration in a multi-hop question-answering system using Mistral, GPT, and Qwen models on HotpotQA and MuSiQue datasets. At the same numerical commitment threshold, calibration changes which questions agents ultimately commit to answering. Across all six model-dataset pairs, it increases accuracy among committed answers by up to 41 percentage points. However, it can reduce coverage and increase retrieval use. Overall accuracy improves by up to 15 percentage points on HotpotQA but falls by up to 17 percentage points on MuSiQue. These effects reflect a shift to a more selective, lower-risk operating point, not improved answers or confidence ranking. A calibration map fitted before retrieval improves held-out calibration through retrieval depths one and two, but is worse than raw confidence at depth three for all three models. Additional evidence helps on average, but this aggregate effect does not establish whether confidence identifies which individual episodes will benefit from another retrieval. Taken together, these results show that calibration can make commitment risk interpretable, but it does not estimate the expected benefit of another retrieval. Retrieval therefore requires a separate value-of-information or utility estimate. Evaluations should report held-out calibration, risk-coverage, and retrieval cost.
articles.titleCn: 评估匹配轨迹重放的置信度门控检索
articles.abstractCn: 交互式语言模型代理使用置信信号来决定是立即回答、检索额外证据（来自内存或外部知识）还是推迟。然而，置信度通常在孤立状态下进行评估，而没有衡量其触发的行动在轨迹层面的后果。我们提出了匹配轨迹重放，这是一种用于比较置信度到行动映射的控制协议。该协议将候选答案状态、证据点、预算和行动成本保持固定。我们使用它来比较原始口头表达的置信度与事后等距校准，在HotpotQA和MuSiQue数据集上使用Mistral、GPT和Qwen模型的多跳问答系统中进行比较。在相同的数值承诺阈值下，校准改变了代理最终承诺回答的问题。在所有六个模型-数据集对中，它将已承诺答案的准确率提高了高达41个百分点。然而，它可能会降低覆盖率并增加检索使用。在HotpotQA上，总体准确率提高了高达15个百分点，但在MuSiQue上则降低了高达17个百分点。这些效应反映了对更选择性、更低风险的运行点的转变，而不是答案或置信度排名的改进。在检索之前拟合的校准图通过检索深度一和深度二改善了保留校准，但在所有三个模型中，在深度三时都比原始置信度差。额外证据平均有帮助，但这种总体效应并不能确定置信度是否识别出哪些单个场景将从另一次检索中受益。综合来看，这些结果表明校准可以使承诺风险变得可解释，但它并不能估计另一次检索的预期收益。因此，检索需要一个单独的信息价值或效用估计。评估应报告保留校准、风险覆盖率和检索成本。

articles.title: SymbolLKG: Towards Verifiable Logical Reasoning via Logical Knowledge Graph and Symbolic Solvers
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in natural language understanding, yet they struggle with strict multi-step reasoning, frequently suffering from hallucinations and inconsistency. Existing solutions like Chain-of-Thought (CoT) lack rigorous verification mechanisms, while standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) often misses the complex, structural dependencies inherent in logical tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose a Neuro-Symbolic architecture that integrates a Logical Knowledge Graph (LKG) with dynamic solver routing. Specifically, we introduce an ontology-based LKG that treats logical rules and constraints as first-class topological nodes, enabling explicit modeling of dependencies extracted from text. We further design a Logic Router to dynamically dispatch tasks to the optimal symbolic engine, which is supported by a topology-aware hybrid retrieval mechanism. Experimental results on logical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms state-of-the-art prompting and RAG baselines, delivering higher accuracy and verifiable reasoning paths.
articles.titleCn: SymbolLKG：通过逻辑知识图谱和符号求解器实现可验证的逻辑推理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在自然语言理解方面展现出卓越的能力，但在严格的、多步骤的推理任务中却表现不佳，经常出现幻觉和矛盾。现有的解决方案，如思维链（CoT），缺乏严谨的验证机制，而标准的检索增强生成（RAG）往往忽略了逻辑任务中固有的复杂结构依赖关系。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了一种神经符号架构，该架构将逻辑知识图谱（LKG）与动态求解器路由相结合。具体而言，我们引入了一种基于本体的LKG，将逻辑规则和约束视为首要的拓扑节点，从而能够显式地建模从文本中提取的依赖关系。我们进一步设计了一个逻辑路由器，用于动态地将任务分配给最优的符号引擎，该机制由拓扑感知的混合检索机制支持。在逻辑推理基准测试上的实验结果表明，我们的框架在提示和RAG基线方面显著优于当前最先进的技术，实现了更高的准确性和可验证的推理路径。

articles.title: RuleWeaver: Benchmarking Rule-Centered Scenario Reasoning for Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to specialized domains, where effective use of domain expertise often requires reasoning over complex rules in concrete scenarios. However, existing benchmarks only partially evaluate this capability, as they either focus on output-level instruction constraints or overlook the distinct roles that rules play in scenario reasoning. To address these gaps, this paper introduces RuleWeaver, a benchmark construction framework for evaluating rule-centered scenario reasoning. RuleWeaver starts from corpus-derived IF-THEN Meta Rules, progressively augments them into complex rules, and composes these rules into rule-centered scenario QA instances. Beyond final-answer correctness, RuleWeaver further supports process-level evaluation through rubric-based answer quality, rule recall, and rule precision. Experiments on 11 representative LLMs show that current models still struggle with complex rule-centered scenario reasoning, with even the best-performing model achieving only around 50% of the maximum rubric score. We make our code and dataset available here: https://github.com/SharkSpicy-NLP/RuleWeaver.
articles.titleCn: RuleWeaver：面向大型语言模型的以规则为中心的场景推理基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地应用于专业领域，在这些领域，有效利用领域专业知识通常需要在具体场景中对复杂规则进行推理。然而，现有的基准测试仅部分评估这种能力，因为它们要么专注于输出级别的指令约束，要么忽略了规则在场景推理中的不同作用。为了解决这些差距，本文介绍了RuleWeaver，这是一个用于评估以规则为中心的场景推理的基准测试构建框架。RuleWeaver从语料库衍生的IF-THEN元规则开始，逐步将其扩展为复杂规则，并将这些规则组合成以规则为中心的场景问答实例。除了最终答案的正确性之外，RuleWeaver还通过基于评分标准的答案质量、规则召回率和规则精确率支持过程级别的评估。在11个代表性LLMs上的实验表明，当前模型在复杂的以规则为中心的场景推理方面仍然存在困难，即使表现最好的模型也仅达到了约50%的评分标准分数。我们在此提供代码和数据集：https://github.com/SharkSpicy-NLP/RuleWeaver。

articles.title: Behavior2Trip: Towards Personalized Travel Planning via User Behavior Trajectory
articles.abstract: Travel planning agents assist users in generating personalized travel plans by modeling their individual preferences. Existing agents either rely on explicit user instructions or engage in multi-turn clarification to elicit user preferences. However, both approaches overlook the rich behavioral signals latent in users' past behaviors, which implicitly encode their preferences. This over-reliance on active user input increases interaction burden and limits plan personalization. To bridge this gap, we introduce a new task, Behavior-Aware Travel Planning, which infers user preferences directly from past behaviors and generates personalized travel plans. To facilitate research on this task, we introduce Behavior2Trip, a benchmark constructed from one of the largest Chinese online travel platforms, comprising 11,400 instances. Each instance represents an average of 39.8 past user behaviors spanning 14 attributes across 5 preference dimensions. We further propose B2T-Agent, a reinforcement learning-based agent that leverages user behavior trajectories, interacts with external tools for preference-aligned retrieval, and maintains an internal memory module. Experiments on Behavior2Trip show that GPT-4.1 achieves a full-constraint pass rate of only 0.5\% on the hardest tasks, while B2T-Agent built upon Qwen3-8B outperforms all baselines, highlighting the substantial challenge of this task. Moreover, Qwen3-8B trained with B2T-Agent also outperforms GPT-4.1 on the TravelPlanner benchmark, demonstrating strong generalization. Code and data are available at https://github.com/BUAA-IRIP-LLM/Behavior2Trip
articles.titleCn: 行为到行程：通过用户行为轨迹实现个性化旅行规划
articles.abstractCn: 旅行规划代理通过模拟用户的个人偏好来帮助用户生成个性化的旅行计划。现有的代理要么依赖明确用户指令，要么通过多轮澄清来获取用户偏好。然而，这两种方法都忽略了用户过去行为中潜在丰富的行为信号，这些信号隐式地编码了用户的偏好。对主动用户输入的过度依赖增加了交互负担，并限制了计划的个性化。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了一个新任务——行为感知旅行规划，该任务直接从过去行为中推断用户偏好并生成个性化旅行计划。为了促进该任务的研究，我们引入了Behavior2Trip，这是一个从中国最大的在线旅行平台之一构建的基准，包含11,400个实例。每个实例代表平均39.8个过去用户行为，跨越5个偏好维度中的14个属性。我们进一步提出了B2T-Agent，这是一个基于强化学习的代理，它利用用户行为轨迹，与外部工具进行偏好对齐检索，并维护一个内部记忆模块。在Behavior2Trip上的实验表明，GPT-4.1在最难的任务上仅实现了0.5%的全约束通过率，而基于Qwen3-8B构建的B2T-Agent优于所有基线，突显了这一任务的巨大挑战。此外，使用B2T-Agent训练的Qwen3-8B在TravelPlanner基准上也优于GPT-4.1，展示了强大的泛化能力。代码和数据可在https://github.com/BUAA-IRIP-LLM/Behavior2Trip获取。

articles.title: Decoupling Planning and Control for Instructable Agents
articles.abstract: Recent work shows that pre-trained, instruction-tuned vision-language models (VLMs) perform well at mapping from instructions and observations to high-level plans, but struggle to realize such plans as reliable low-latency action sequences in unfamiliar environments. At the same time, world-model controllers excel at fast observation-to-action control, but lack open-ended task guidance. In this work, we combine these strengths into a single system, Instruct-to-Act, where we train a world-model controller to act autonomously at high frequency when conditioned on sparse, higher-latency, and high-level text instructions generated by a VLM planner. To train controllers to be language-instructable, we relabel segments of controller policy rollouts with synthetic instructions and jointly optimize a behavior-cloning objective along with existing reward-maximizing and world-modeling objectives. We evaluate our proposed approach across seven embodied environments, including three multi-agent environments where VLM planners coordinate through language while trained controllers serve as their actuators. Under matched observation and action spaces, our decoupled approach consistently outperforms controller-only and direct VLM action-generation variants, preserves fast control, and lets us swap in different pretrained VLM planners without fine-tuning, while remaining competitive with strong vision-language-action and multi-agent RL baselines on six of seven tasks.
articles.comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026. Project page: https://zinengtang.github.io/instruct-to-act/
articles.titleCn: 为指令型智能体解耦规划与控制
articles.abstractCn: 近期研究表明，预训练并经过指令微调的视觉语言模型（VLMs）在将指令和观察映射到高级计划方面表现良好，但在陌生环境中实现这些计划为可靠的低延迟动作序列方面存在困难。与此同时，世界模型控制器在快速观察-动作控制方面表现出色，但缺乏开放式的任务指导。在这项工作中，我们将这些优势结合到一个名为Instruct-to-Act的单一系统中，其中我们训练一个世界模型控制器，在接收由VLM规划器生成的稀疏、高延迟、高级文本指令时，能够以高频自主行动。为了训练语言可指令的控制器，我们使用合成指令重新标记控制器策略滚动的片段，并联合优化行为克隆目标以及现有的奖励最大化与世界建模目标。我们在七个具身环境中评估了我们的方法，包括三个多智能体环境，其中VLM规划器通过语言进行协调，而训练好的控制器作为它们的执行器。在匹配的观察和动作空间下，我们的解耦方法始终优于仅控制器和直接VLM动作生成变体，保持了快速控制，并允许我们无需微调即可切换不同的预训练VLM规划器，同时在七个任务中的六个任务上与强大的视觉语言动作和多智能体RL基线保持竞争力。

articles.title: Instruction Quality Matters: Refining Instructions for Effective Preference Learning
articles.abstract: Preference learning optimizes models using response pairs, yet the informativeness of these pairs is fundamentally shaped by the instructions from which they are generated. We identify instruction quality as a hidden bottleneck in preference learning: low-quality or ambiguous instructions restrict the response-quality distribution, limiting strong chosen responses and weakening preference signals. Through Best- and Worst-of-N analyses, we show that instruction quality constrains both the ceiling and floor of sampled response quality. Motivated by this observation, we introduce an instruction-refinement pipeline that selects weak instructions using reward signals and revises them with rubric-guided LLM feedback, improving preference data without discarding examples. Across offline and online preference learning settings, experiments on multiple models and benchmarks show broad alignment improvements over original data and alternative data-improvement strategies. Further analyses indicate that instruction refinement raises achievable response quality and complements response-centric preference data curation. Overall, instruction quality emerges as a key factor governing how informative preference signals are formed for LLM alignment. Code is available at: https://github.com/01choco/instruction-refinement/
articles.titleCn: 指令质量很重要：优化指令以实现有效的偏好学习
articles.abstractCn: 偏好学习通过响应对优化模型，但这些对的 информативность (informativeness) 基本上由其生成的指令决定。我们识别出指令质量是偏好学习中的一个隐藏瓶颈：低质量或模糊的指令会限制响应质量分布，从而限制强选择响应并削弱偏好信号。通过最佳N和最差N分析，我们证明指令质量限制了采样响应质量的上下限。基于这一观察，我们引入了一个指令优化流程，该流程使用奖励信号选择弱指令，并使用评分指导的大型语言模型反馈来修改它们，从而在不丢弃示例的情况下改进偏好数据。在离线和在线偏好学习设置中，对多个模型和基准的实验表明，与原始数据和替代数据改进策略相比，我们的方法取得了广泛的改进。进一步分析表明，指令优化提高了可实现的响应质量，并补充了以响应为中心的偏好数据管理。总体而言，指令质量成为决定LLM对齐中偏好信号如何形成信息的关键因素。代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/01choco/instruction-refinement/

articles.title: Equal Ranking Quality, Different Decisions: Training Order-Consistent LLM Scorers
articles.abstract: Rerankers, reward models and multi-document QA scorers score candidate documents or responses in one LLM prompt, so each score depends on their order. Such scorers are selected on ranking quality, but their scores determine a decision: what a score threshold retains, a reader answers, or a preference model selects. However, equal ranking quality does not imply equal decisions: on passage reranking, five trained scorers within 0.010 nDCG@10 retain sets that overlap by only 0.66-0.84 when reordered. A published reranker takes the highest retained-set F1 in our comparison and still overlaps by only 0.667. No prompt-time change we test removes that order dependence: the only one that gains ranking quality leaves all three decisions unchanged. Order-consistency SFT (OC-SFT) attenuates it in the weights, training a candidate's score not to depend on the order. It holds ranking quality and leads every decision-stability measure among trained scorers on all three tasks: it flips the reader's answer on 0.125 of permutation pairs against 0.149-0.164 for three other objectives that target order. It is more stable than order-averaged distillation on 12 base models, and one OC-SFT permutation retains sets that overlap more than ten averaged off-the-shelf permutations. A comparison should therefore report what a threshold retains and a reader answers, not ranking quality alone. Code is available at https://github.com/thomsonreuters/presentation-dependence.
articles.titleCn: 同等排名质量，不同决策：训练顺序一致的大型语言模型评分器
articles.abstractCn: 排序器、奖励模型和多文档问答评分器在一个大型语言模型提示中为候选文档或响应打分，因此每个分数都取决于它们的顺序。这些评分器是根据排序质量进行选择的，但它们的分数决定了决策：什么分数阈值保留、读者回答或偏好模型选择。然而，相同的排序质量并不等同于相同的决策：在段落重新排序时，五个训练好的评分器在重新排序后保留的集合重叠度仅为0.66-0.84，尽管它们的排序质量相同。在我们的比较中，一个已发表的排序器仍然保留了0.667的重叠度。我们测试的所有提示时间变化都无法消除这种顺序依赖性：唯一提高排序质量的方法是使所有三个决策保持不变。顺序一致性监督微调（OC-SFT）通过权重减轻了这种依赖性，训练候选分数不依赖于顺序。它保持了排序质量，并在所有三个任务上使训练评分器的每个决策稳定性指标都达到最优：它在0.125的置换对中改变了读者的回答，而在其他三个针对顺序的目标中，该值为0.149-0.164。在12个基础模型上，OC-SFT比顺序平均蒸馏更稳定，并且一个OC-SFT置换保留的集合重叠度超过十个平均现成置换。因此，比较应该报告什么分数阈值保留和读者回答，而不仅仅是排序质量。代码可在https://github.com/thomsonreuters/presentation-dependence获取。

articles.title: Letters hide the truth from our eyes: English homophones have meaningfully different phonetic realizations
articles.abstract: The distribution of spoken word duration of English homophones is known to co-vary with frequency of use. This study investigates whether other aspects of the phonetic realization of homophones also differ. A series of quantitative investigations of 14,000 homophone tokens in American television news broadcasts revealed that the tokens of homophone pairs such as \textit{weight} and \textit{wait} have different phonetic realizations, and that these can be predicted from their meanings in utterance context. These systematic differences remain even when taking duration-related variation into account. Time-normalized spectrograms emerged as an excellent tool for probing the fine details of phonetic realization, and obviate the need for phonetic transcriptions, which inevitably hide the phonetic truth from our eyes.
articles.titleCn: 文字会遮蔽真相：英语中的同音异义词有着有意义的语音实现差异
articles.abstractCn: 英语同音异义词的口语发音持续时间已知会随使用频率变化。本研究探讨了同音异义词的语音实现的其他方面是否也存在差异。对美国电视新闻报道中14,000个同音异义词符号的一系列定量研究揭示，诸如“weight”和“wait”这样的同音异义词对符号具有不同的语音实现，并且这些差异可以根据其在话语语境中的含义进行预测。即使考虑了与持续时间相关的变异，这些系统性差异仍然存在。时间标准化声谱图成为探究语音实现细节的绝佳工具，并消除了对语音转写的需求，后者不可避免地会遮蔽语音真相。

articles.title: Preserving General Capabilities during Domain Specialization with Uncertainty-Calibrated MOPD
articles.abstract: Specializing large language models to vertical domains improves domain-specific behavior but often degrades general capabilities such as reasoning, coding, instruction following, and creative writing. We study this domain--general trade-off in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD), where a specialized student is supervised on its own sampled trajectories by domain and general teachers. Standard MOPD faces two limitations: ordinary on-policy sampling rarely exposes tokens with large positive teacher--student advantages, while the advantage sign alone does not establish whether the resulting update direction is reliable. We propose uncertainty-calibrated MOPD to address these limitations. Dual-temperature sampling broadens the candidate trajectory pool, and positive-advantage-density filtering selects trajectories with stronger positive learning signals. Centered log-likelihood (CLL) filtering then computes an entropy-calibrated teacher-endorsement score and probabilistically retains token updates according to direction--endorsement consistency. Experiments on role-playing and medical-domain specialization show that our method improves the general-capability average over standard MOPD by $4.73\%$ and $10.84\%$, respectively, while maintaining vertical-domain performance. Ablations and diagnostic analyses further confirm that the gains do not merely result from a larger rollout budget and that the proposed trajectory- and token-level mechanisms address their intended failure modes.
articles.titleCn: 在不确定性校准的MOPD域专业化过程中保留通用能力
articles.abstractCn: 在垂直领域专门化大型语言模型可以提高特定领域的行为表现，但通常会导致推理、编码、指令遵循和创意写作等通用能力的退化。我们研究了多教师策略蒸馏（MOPD）中的领域-通用性权衡问题，其中专门化的学生模型通过领域教师和通用教师对其自身采样的轨迹进行监督。标准MOPD面临两个限制：常规策略蒸馏采样很少暴露具有显著教师-学生优势的标记，而优势符号本身并不能确定所产生的更新方向是否可靠。我们提出了不确定性校准的MOPD来解决这些限制。双温度采样扩展了候选轨迹池，正优势密度过滤选择具有更强正向学习信号的轨迹，中心对数似然（CLL）过滤则计算熵校准的教师认可分数，并根据方向-认可一致性概率性地保留标记更新。在角色扮演和医疗领域专门化的实验表明，我们的方法在保持垂直领域性能的同时，分别比标准MOPD提高了4.73%和10.84%的通用能力平均表现。消融实验和诊断分析进一步证实，这些提升并非仅仅源于更大的部署预算，并且所提出的轨迹级和标记级机制有效解决了其预期的失效模式。

articles.title: Towards Expert Financial QA via Self-Improving RAG
articles.abstract: Expert-level financial question answering requires both grounded verification to catch numeric hallucinations and audit trails for regulatory compliance, attributes that standard single-pass RAG systems lack. We take a step toward this goal with Self-Improving RAG, a framework that decomposes document QA into three specialized agents (Retrieval, Reasoning, and Judge) coordinated by an orchestrator with feedback-driven self-correction. When the Judge Agent scores an answer below a dynamic threshold, the system triggers retry with escalated strategies: broader retrieval, more careful prompting, and relaxed acceptance criteria. We evaluate on FinanceBench (SEC filing QA), where Self-Improving RAG achieves 86% oracle-guided accuracy (measuring agreement with gold answers) with a 36.4% Lazarus Rate, recovering nearly 4 in 10 initially incorrect answers through targeted retry. A key finding is that a fixed retrieval pipeline with judge-driven retry achieves strong results without dynamic routing, providing full interpretability. Every decision is logged with confidence scores, enabling the audit trails required for regulated financial applications.

articles.titleCn: 通过自改进RAG实现专家级金融问答
articles.abstractCn: 专家级金融问题回答需要具备基于事实的验证能力以捕捉数字幻觉，以及用于监管合规的审计追踪，而标准的单次通过RAG系统缺乏这些属性。我们通过自我改进型RAG框架朝着这一目标迈出了一步，该框架将文档问答分解为三个专门代理（检索、推理和判断），并由一个具有反馈驱动自我修正能力的协调器进行协调。当判断代理给出的答案评分低于动态阈值时，系统会触发使用升级策略的重试：扩大检索范围、更加谨慎的提示以及放宽接受标准。我们在FinanceBench（SEC文件问答）上进行了评估，自我改进型RAG达到了86%的或然引导准确率（衡量与标准答案的一致性），具有36.4%的Lazarus率，通过针对性的重试纠正了近四分之一的初始错误答案。一个关键发现是，固定检索流程配合判断驱动的重试能够取得优异结果，无需动态路由即可实现完全可解释性。每项决策都会记录置信度分数，从而为受监管的金融应用提供所需的审计追踪。

articles.title: PragAlign: Evidence-Sensitive Reply Assistance Across Chinese and Japanese Appropriateness Judgments
articles.abstract: Reply assistance in multilingual settings requires linguistic competence and culturally situated judgments of appropriateness. We present PragAlign, which separates context reading from selective clarification, and evaluate it alongside Direct and Rule. Nine native Chinese speakers judged Chinese materials, while three native Japanese speakers judged matched Japanese versions. In the Chinese evaluation, PragAlign received significantly better ranks than both baselines. In the Japanese evaluation, Direct had the lowest mean rank, PragAlign had the highest top-rank rate, and the omnibus difference was not significant. The groups selected the same top condition in 5 of 10 scenarios, including four shared PragAlign selections. The results identify shared and language-specific judgment patterns and inform reply assistance designed to support linguistic and cultural understanding.
articles.titleCn: PragAlign：针对中日恰当性判断的证据敏感应答辅助
articles.abstractCn: 在多语言环境下的回复辅助需要语言能力和基于文化情境的适宜性判断。我们提出了PragAlign，它将上下文理解与选择性澄清分离，并与Direct和Rule一起进行评估。九位中文母语者评判中文材料，而三位日语母语者评判匹配的日语版本。在中国评估中，PragAlign的排名显著优于两个基线。在日本评估中，Direct的平均排名最低，PragAlign的顶级排名率最高，但总体差异不显著。在十个场景中有五个场景选出了相同的顶级条件，其中包括四个共享的PragAlign选择。结果识别了共享和语言特定的评判模式，并为设计旨在支持语言和文化理解的回复辅助提供了信息。

articles.title: Scaling phoneme-based TTS augmentation for ASR: A unified pipeline and controlled study
articles.abstract: Synthetic speech provides scalable supervision for automatic speech recognition (ASR), but its benefit depends on the selected texts, reference speech, and amount of synthesized data. We present a unified phoneme-based TTS-to-ASR augmentation pipeline built around a multilingual TTS model trained from scratch using the F5-TTS architecture with language-ID conditioning. The pipeline combines language-specific grapheme-to-phoneme conversion, reference-speech filtering, candidate-text selection, synthesis, and matched ASR continuation. We further propose phoneme-frequency-guided selection (PFGS), which ranks candidate sentences using phoneme frequencies estimated from real ASR training labels. Experiments with separate monolingual ASR systems for Arabic, French, Italian, and Portuguese span 13 test sets. Across the synthesis-scale sweep, random augmentation improves over matched real-only continuation on 11 test sets. Under a nominal 60% synthesis budget, PFGS improves over real-only training on 12 test sets and over random selection on 9. Its largest relative word error rate (WER) reduction against random selection is 19.3%. With target texts and synthesis counts fixed, reference-speech filtering reduces absolute WER by 0.29 and 0.59 points on Italian and French Common Voice, respectively. These results identify synthesis scale, candidate-text content, and reference quality as important control variables in TTS-based ASR augmentation.
articles.titleCn: 基于音素的TTS增强技术在语音识别中的应用：统一流程与受控研究
articles.abstractCn: 合成语音为自动语音识别（ASR）提供了可扩展的监督，但其效益取决于所选文本、参考语音以及合成数据的数量。我们提出了一种基于音素的TTS到ASR增强流程，该流程围绕一个使用F5-TTS架构从头开始训练的多语言TTS模型构建，并带有语言ID条件。该流程结合了特定语言的字素到音素转换、参考语音过滤、候选文本选择、合成以及匹配的ASR延续。我们进一步提出了音素频率引导选择（PFGS），该技术使用从真实ASR训练标签中估计的音素频率对候选句子进行排序。实验涵盖了阿拉伯语、法语、意大利语和葡萄牙语的13个测试集，分别使用独立的单语ASR系统进行。在合成规模扫描中，随机增强在11个测试集上优于匹配的真实数据延续。在名义的60%合成预算下，PFGS在12个测试集上优于真实数据训练，在9个测试集上优于随机选择。其相对于随机选择的最高相对字错误率（WER）降低为19.3%。在目标文本和合成计数固定的情况下，参考语音过滤在意大利语和法语Common Voice上分别将绝对WER降低了0.29和0.59个百分点。这些结果确定了合成规模、候选文本内容和参考质量为基于TTS的ASR增强的重要控制变量。

articles.title: Beyond Reflection: Affirmation as a Promising Behavioral Marker Associated with Quality in Text-Based Counseling
articles.abstract: While AI-assisted text-based counseling is gaining attention, it remains empirically unclear which counselor behaviors are associated with higher dialogue quality. Existing research often focuses heavily on Reflection, borrowing frameworks from Motivational Interviewing. To address this gap, we conduct a multi-layered analysis using KokoroChat, a large-scale Japanese text counseling dataset conducted by professional counselors and trainees, newly annotated with counselor strategy tags and client distress levels. Our results show that, under the quality indicators used in this study, Affirmation is more consistently associated with session quality than Reflection among the analyzed strategies. Cross-dataset transfer experiments further suggest that this quality signal can be observed to some extent on ESConv, an English dataset with non-expert supporters. These findings provide empirical implications for counselor training and emotional support system design. We release the additional KokoroChat annotations and experimental source code at https://github.com/UEC-InabaLab/BeyondReflection.
articles.titleCn: 超越反思：肯定作为与文本咨询质量相关的有前景的行为指标
articles.abstractCn: 尽管AI辅助的文本式咨询正受到关注，但哪些咨询师行为与更高的对话质量相关，这一点在实证上仍不明确。现有研究通常过度关注反映（Reflection），并借鉴动机访谈（Motivational Interviewing）的框架。为填补这一空白，我们使用KokoroChat——一个由专业咨询师和实习生进行的大规模日语文本咨询数据集，该数据集新标注了咨询师策略标签和客户痛苦程度——进行了多层面分析。我们的结果表明，在本研究中使用的质量指标下，肯定（Affirmation）比反映（Reflection）在所分析的策略中与咨询质量更为一致相关。跨数据集迁移实验进一步表明，这种质量信号在一定程度上也可以在ESConv（一个包含非专家支持者的英语数据集）中观察到。这些发现为咨询师培训和情感支持系统设计提供了实证启示。我们在https://github.com/UEC-InabaLab/BeyondReflection上发布了额外的KokoroChat标注和实验源代码。

articles.title: BLANC: Discovering Patent White Space via Changes in Normalized Pointwise Mutual Information Between Multi-View Clusters
articles.abstract: Identifying white space --- the unexplored but potentially valuable regions of a patent landscape --- is essential for strategic R&D planning, yet existing methods rely on manual patent mapping or apply single-view clustering without quantitative gap detection. We propose BLANC (Blank Landscape Analysis through NPMI Conditioning), a three-phase pipeline combining (1) multi-view neural topic modeling along three semantic dimensions (application/use, novelty, inventive step); (2) Normalized Pointwise Mutual Information (NPMI) to quantify cross-dimensional cluster association; and (3) conditional detection that flags combinations whose NPMI drops when the corpus is filtered by a user-specified keyword. The drop is captured by a new metric, $Δ$NPMI, which identifies combinations "established globally, unexplored locally." Because white space has no ground truth, we evaluate BLANC on two public USPTO corpora --- machine learning/AI (5,417 patents, CPC G06N) and glass compositions (1,982 patents, CPC C03C) --- by artificially depleting known technology combinations and testing recovery. When three-quarters of a target pair's documents are removed, BLANC recovers 34.1% (ML/AI) and 27.3% (glass) of the depleted combinations, whereas size-matched removals not aimed at them (random documents, or those of a different established combination) essentially never do: the target is never recovered in 191 decoy trials. Collapsing the three semantic views into one recovers nothing, while prior co-occurrence measures also flag the target under random removal, offering no specificity. In a proprietary case (302 float glass / glass-ceramics patents), the keyword "fluorine" reveals a fluorine surface treatment $\times$ warpage suppression candidate ($Δ$NPMI up to 0.48) that experts had independently identified.

articles.titleCn: BLANC：通过多视图聚类间归一化点互信息的变化发现专利空白
articles.abstractCn: 识别专利布局中的空白区域——那些尚未探索但具有潜在价值的领域——对于战略研发规划至关重要，然而现有方法依赖于人工专利绘制或单视角聚类，缺乏定量缺口检测。我们提出了BLANC（通过NPMI条件进行空白景观分析）方法，这是一个三阶段流程，结合了（1）沿三个语义维度（应用/用途、新颖性、创造性步骤）的多视角神经主题建模；（2）归一化点互信息（NPMI）来量化跨维度聚类关联；（3）条件检测，标记在用户指定关键词过滤语料库时NPMI值下降的组合。这种下降通过新指标$Δ$NPMI捕捉，该指标识别出“全球确立、局部未探索”的组合。由于空白区域缺乏真实标签，我们在两个公开的USPTO语料库上评估BLANC——机器学习/AI（5,417项专利，CPC G06N）和玻璃成分（1,982项专利，CPC C03C），通过人为消耗已知技术组合并测试恢复效果。当目标对中四分之三的文档被移除时，BLANC恢复了34.1%（ML/AI）和27.3%（玻璃）的被消耗组合，而大小匹配的非目标移除（随机文档或不同确立组合的文档）几乎从不成功：在191次诱饵试验中从未恢复目标。将三个语义视角合并为一个视角则一无所获，而先前的共现度量在随机移除下也标记目标，缺乏特异性。在一个专有案例（302项浮法玻璃/玻璃陶瓷专利）中，关键词“氟”揭示了一个氟表面处理$\times$翘曲抑制候选组合（$Δ$NPMI高达0.48），该组合已被专家独立识别。

articles.title: FOCUS & RePAIR: Mitigating Text Degeneration via Token-Level Guidance for Pruned Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Pruning is a practical approach to compress large language models (LLMs), but it can amplify text degeneration, especially repetition loops, even when perplexity and task accuracy remain largely unchanged. In this work, we present a token-level analysis of this failure mode by viewing decoding as a dynamical process that enters and persists in a small set of recurrent contexts. Our analysis decomposes degeneration into loop entry risk and loop persistence, and shows that persistence is controlled by the escape mass assigned to plausible alternatives within the token sampling set. Motivated by these findings, we propose two token-level guidance objectives for post-pruning fine-tuning. FOCUS reweights distillation toward high-confidence teacher regions to suppress leakage, while RePAIR uses onset-centered positive/negative continuation pairs with a margin loss to promote plausible alternatives and prevent early commitment to repetition loops. Experiments on open-ended continuation and instruction-based generation show that both methods consistently reduce repetition and improve generation quality.

articles.titleCn: 聚焦与修复：通过标记级指导减轻剪枝大型语言模型的文本退化
articles.abstractCn: 剪枝是压缩大型语言模型（LLM）的一种实用方法，但它可能放大文本退化，尤其是在困惑度和任务准确度基本保持不变的情况下，退化表现为重复循环。在这项工作中，我们通过将解码视为一个进入并持续存在于一小部分循环上下文中的动态过程，来分析这种失败模式。我们的分析将退化分解为循环进入风险和循环持续，并表明持续受分配给标记采样集中合理替代方案的逃逸质量所控制。基于这些发现，我们提出了两种用于剪枝后微调的标记级指导目标。FOCUS通过将蒸馏重新加权到高置信度的教师区域来抑制泄漏，而RePAIR使用以起始点为中心的正面/负面延续对和边距损失来促进合理替代方案，并防止过早进入重复循环。在开放式延续和指令式生成上的实验表明，这两种方法都能一致地减少重复并提高生成质量。

articles.title: Do LLMs Understand Personality? Rethinking Persona Fidelity Evaluation through Structured Behavioral Inference
articles.abstract: As large language models are increasingly deployed to simulate diverse human characters, ensuring persona fidelity, defined as the extent to which an agent's behavior consistently reflects the psychological and stylistic characteristics of a target persona, has become a critical requirement. However, existing evaluation paradigms primarily rely on either holistic LLM-based judges, which are prone to "holistic appraisal hallucination'', or static psychometric inventories, which fail to capture the context-dependent fidelity required in dynamic dialogue. To address these limitations, we propose PRISM (Persona Reasoning with Inverse SFL-based Modeling), a psycholinguistically grounded framework that reformulates persona fidelity evaluation as a structured inverse inference task. Inspired by Systemic Functional Linguistics (SFL), PRISM decomposes persona fidelity into three functional dimensions: Task Framing, Interpersonal Stance, and Linguistic Style. It estimates dimension-specific evidence over a persona-conditioned label space and aggregates these signals into an interpretable and auditable evaluation process. Experiments show that PRISM yields more accurate and stable judgements than traditional holistic judging, providing a more reliable framework for persona fidelity evaluation.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型理解人格吗？通过结构化行为推断重新思考角色保真度评估
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型越来越多地用于模拟多样化的人类角色，确保角色一致性——即智能体的行为在多大程度上始终反映目标角色的心理和风格特征——已成为一项关键要求。然而，现有的评估范式主要依赖于整体LLM评估者，这些评估者容易产生“整体评估幻觉”，或者静态的心理测量清单，这些清单无法捕捉动态对话中所需的上下文相关一致性。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了PRISM（基于逆功能语言学建模的角色推理），这是一个以心理学为基础的框架，将角色一致性评估重新表述为一个结构化的逆推理任务。受系统功能语言学的启发，PRISM将角色一致性分解为三个功能维度：任务框架、人际立场和语言风格。它在角色条件标签空间中估计特定维度的证据，并将这些信号聚合到一个可解释和可审计的评估过程中。实验表明，与传统的整体评估相比，PRISM能够提供更准确和稳定的判断，为角色一致性评估提供了一个更可靠的框架。

articles.title: Meta-Learning Where to Allocate Experts: Task-Conditioned Layer-Wise Compression for MoEs
articles.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models route each token to a subset of expert networks, increasing capacity while keeping per-token computation sparse. In many deployed MoEs, the number of active experts is fixed across layers and tasks, although layer roles and expert redundancy vary with depth and demand varies with difficulty. Existing approaches address only part of this setting: layer-wise allocations are usually determined offline and reused for all tasks, while token-level methods vary expert activation using local routing signals without task-level context. We propose MetaNet, a support-set controller that predicts, for each layer, an expert-retention threshold and a bounded routing bias. The backbone, experts, and router remain frozen. On DeepSeek-MoE-16B-Chat, MetaNet provides a tunable accuracy-expert-activation trade-off. Relative to fixed k=6, a conservative setting activates 3.61 experts on average (40% fewer) and achieves comparable MMLU accuracy (0.489 vs. 0.474), whereas an aggressive setting activates 2.28 experts on average (62% fewer) with accuracy approximately 3.7 percentage points lower. The MMLU-trained controller also transfers to C-Eval without retraining, activating 2.90 experts on average (52% fewer than fixed k=6) at 0.386 accuracy.
articles.titleCn: 元学习：如何分配专家——面向MoEs的任务条件层压缩
articles.abstractCn: 专家混合（MoE）模型将每个token路由到一组专家网络子集，在保持每token计算稀疏的同时增加了模型容量。在许多部署的MoE模型中，各层的激活专家数量是固定的，尽管层角色和专家冗余随深度变化，任务难度也影响需求。现有方法仅解决了部分问题：层分配通常离线确定并用于所有任务，而token级方法通过局部路由信号调整专家激活，但缺乏任务级上下文。我们提出了MetaNet，一种支持集控制器，为每一层预测专家保留阈值和有界路由偏差。骨干网络、专家网络和路由器保持冻结。在DeepSeek-MoE-16B-Chat上，MetaNet提供了可调节的准确性与专家激活之间的权衡。相对于固定的k=6，保守设置平均激活3.61个专家（减少40%），并达到相当的MMLU准确率（0.489 vs. 0.474），而激进设置平均激活2.28个专家（减少62%），准确率约低3.7个百分点。MMLU训练的控制器也能迁移到C-Eval，无需重新训练，平均激活2.90个专家（比固定k=6减少52%），准确率达0.386。

articles.title: Information-Guided Frontier Decoding: Contextual Utility-Driven Commitment in dMLLMs
articles.abstract: Decoding quality in diffusion multimodal language models (dMLLMs) depends heavily on the order in which masked tokens are committed. Existing confidence-based strategies prioritize locally easy tokens, but confidence does not necessarily reflect contextual usefulness. As a result, structurally easy tokens such as punctuation may be committed before informative semantic anchors, weakening context propagation and increasing error accumulation. We propose Information-Guided Frontier Decoding (IGFD), a training-free decoding strategy that ranks candidates using token confidence, neighborhood uncertainty, and structural commitment risk. IGFD encourages early commitment of reliable semantic anchors while delaying fragile structural tokens, improving contextual support during decoding. A dynamic candidate frontier further constrains token selection to locally expandable regions under the same decoding budget. The method requires no additional training, auxiliary models, or extra forward passes. Experiments across multimodal understanding, reasoning, grounding, and hallucination benchmarks show that IGFD consistently outperforms existing decoding strategies across the majority of benchmarks and diffusion MLLM backbones under identical decoding budgets.
articles.titleCn: 信息引导前沿解码：dMLLMs中的情境效用驱动承诺
articles.abstractCn: 在扩散多模态语言模型（dMLLMs）中解码质量高度依赖于掩码标记提交的顺序。现有的基于置信度的策略优先处理局部容易的标记，但置信度并不一定反映上下文中的有用性。因此，结构上容易的标记（如标点符号）可能会在信息丰富的语义锚点之前被提交，削弱了上下文传播并增加了错误累积。我们提出了信息引导前沿解码（IGFD），这是一种无需训练的解码策略，它通过标记置信度、邻域不确定性以及结构承诺风险对候选进行排序。IGFD鼓励早期提交可靠的语义锚点，同时延迟脆弱的结构标记，从而在解码过程中提升上下文支持。一个动态候选前沿进一步约束标记选择，使其在相同的解码预算下仅选择局部可扩展区域。该方法无需额外的训练、辅助模型或额外的前向传递。在多模态理解、推理、定位和幻觉基准测试中的实验表明，在相同的解码预算下，IGFD在大多数基准测试和扩散MLLM骨干网络中始终优于现有的解码策略。

articles.title: Which Metrics Save the Most Human Annotation? Prediction-Powered Evaluation and Meta-Evaluation
articles.abstract: Across various non-verifiable tasks, human evaluation is reliable but expensive, while automatic metrics are more scalable but often biased. Building on prediction-powered inference (PPI), we propose prediction-powered evaluation, a framework that combines limited human judgments with large-scale automatic scores to obtain data-efficient system comparisons that are provably unbiased. We develop parametric and non-parametric procedures, analyze the efficiency trade-off between paired and unpaired designs, and validate the framework on six WMT datasets. We further introduce the Prediction-Powered Saving Ratio (PPSR), a meta-metric that measures how much human annotation an automatic metric can save when used within prediction-powered evaluation. PPSR directly targets metric utility for prediction-powered evaluation and yields more discriminative and stable metric rankings than existing system-level meta-metrics. Overall, our new paradigm reframes automatic metrics as tools for reducing human annotation cost rather than replacing human judgment, and applies broadly to non-verifiable tasks.
articles.comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 (Main). Code available: https://github.com/CHATS-lab/ppi-eval
articles.titleCn: 哪些指标最能节省人工标注？基于预测的评估与元评估
articles.abstractCn: 在各种不可验证的任务中，人工评估虽然可靠但成本高昂，而自动指标更具可扩展性但往往存在偏差。基于预测驱动的推理（PPI），我们提出了预测驱动的评估，这是一个结合有限的专家判断和大规模自动分数的框架，以获得可证明无偏的数据高效系统比较。我们开发了参数化和非参数化程序，分析了配对设计与非配对设计之间的效率权衡，并在六个WMT数据集上验证了该框架。我们进一步引入了预测驱动节省率（PPSR），这是一个元指标，用于衡量自动指标在预测驱动评估中可以节省多少人工标注。PPSR直接针对预测驱动评估的指标效用，并比现有的系统级元指标产生更具区分性和稳定性的指标排名。总体而言，我们的新范式将自动指标重新定义为降低人工标注成本的工具，而不是取代人工判断，并广泛应用于不可验证任务。

articles.title: The Thousand-Graph Hypothesis: A Testable Hypothesis of Task-Conditioned Relation Materialization in Repository-Level Code Reasoning
articles.abstract: Large software repositories are often beyond model context limits. Training repository knowledge into models is costly and quickly stale, while local retrieval can miss scattered requirements, and explicit relation graphs add ongoing maintenance burden. We propose an entity-only external interface with task-conditioned relation materialization during inference. A two-layer index separates global routing from local entity focus and is evaluated on DeepSeek-V4-Flash and SWE-bench Verified. The base, one-layer, and two-layer conditions achieve 92.1%, 94.2%, and 95.6% success, respectively, under zero pre-built entity-relation edges.
articles.titleCn: 千图假设：一种可检验的库级代码推理中任务条件关系显化的假设
articles.abstractCn: 大型软件仓库往往超出模型上下文限制。将仓库知识训练到模型中成本高昂且迅速过时，而本地检索可能遗漏分散的需求，显式关系图则增加了持续的维护负担。我们提出了一种仅包含实体的外部接口，在推理过程中根据任务条件实现关系显化。双层索引将全局路由与本地实体聚焦分离，并在DeepSeek-V4-Flash和SWE-bench验证集上进行了评估。基础单层条件、单层条件和双层条件在无预构建实体-关系边的情况下，分别实现了92.1%、94.2%和95.6%的成功率。

articles.title: Not Just Reason, Not Just Scan: Reinforcement Learning for Proactive Scientific Error Verification over Academic Paper
articles.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly capable scientific assistants, yet they remain far from fully autonomous research. This transition requires models to actively inspect academic papers, build global evidence views, and make traceable judgments without prespecified issues or evidence. However, existing work provides limited task paradigms or training studies for such issue- and evidence-absent verification. We study this challenge through scientific error detection, where models must determine whether errors exist and justify them with evidence-based reasoning. To fill this gap, we present VERA-RL, a reinforcement-learning formulation for scientific error detection over academic papers. Following a Reason--Verify--Scan progression, we construct VERA-13K, a 12,900-sample dataset organized into 4,300 matched chains, covering 6 scientific-error categories across the research workflow and broad natural-science domains. We further introduce fine-grained rewards for reasoning completeness, evidence alignment, and error precision. Training Qwen3-VL-8B with VERA-RL substantially improves verifiable reasoning, approaching flagship MLLMs such as Gemini 3 Pro and Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B on Scan.
articles.titleCn: 不只是推理，不只是扫描：强化学习在学术论文主动科学错误验证中的应用
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）正逐渐成为越来越强大的科学助手，但它们距离完全自主的研究仍有很长的路要走。这种转变需要模型主动检查学术论文，构建全局证据视图，并在没有预设问题或证据的情况下做出可追溯的判断。然而，现有工作在缺乏问题与证据验证的任务范式或训练研究方面提供了有限的资源。我们通过科学错误检测这一挑战来研究这一问题，其中模型必须判断是否存在错误，并基于证据进行推理来证明。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了VERA-RL，这是一种用于学术论文科学错误检测的强化学习框架。遵循推理—验证—扫描的流程，我们构建了VERA-13K，这是一个包含12,900个样本的数据集，分为4,300个匹配链，涵盖了研究工作流程中6种科学错误类别以及广泛的自然科学领域。我们进一步引入了针对推理完整性、证据一致性和错误精确度的细粒度奖励机制。使用VERA-RL训练Qwen3-VL-8B显著提升了可验证推理能力，使其在Scan测试中接近了Gemini 3 Pro和Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B等旗舰级MLLMs的水平。

articles.title: Benchmarking Clinical Decision Pathway Adherence in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Following clinical decision pathways (CDPs) defined by clinical practice guidelines is essential for safe and reliable medical decision-making. However, existing medical large language model (LLM) benchmarks mainly evaluate final-answer accuracy, providing limited evaluation of models' ability to adhere to guidelines. To address this gap, we introduce MEGA-CDP, a benchmark for evaluating whether medical LLMs can generate guideline-adherent CDPs using provided guidelines as references. MEGA-CDP is constructed from 2,274 English and Chinese clinical practice guidelines through a guideline-to-case pipeline, yielding 42,353 clinical cases with explicit reference CDPs. It supports both single-turn vignette and multi-turn interactive settings, and introduces a CDP-oriented evaluation framework for measuring pathway consistency. Experiments on 16 representative LLMs show that reliable clinical decision support remains challenging for current models, demonstrating the need for CDP-oriented evaluation and the value of MEGA-CDP for advancing guideline adherence in medical LLMs.
articles.titleCn: 在大语言模型中评估临床决策路径依从性
articles.abstractCn: 遵循临床实践指南定义的临床决策路径（CDP）对于安全可靠的医疗决策至关重要。然而，现有的医疗大型语言模型（LLM）基准主要评估最终答案的准确性，对模型遵循指南的能力评估有限。为填补这一空白，我们引入MEGA-CDP，这是一个用于评估医疗LLM能否利用提供的指南作为参考生成遵循指南的CDP的基准。MEGA-CDP通过指南到案例的管道，从2,274份英文和中文临床实践指南中构建，生成了42,353个具有明确参考CDP的临床案例。它支持单轮案例摘要和多轮交互设置，并引入了面向CDP的评估框架来衡量路径一致性。在16个代表性LLM上的实验表明，当前模型在提供可靠的临床决策支持方面仍面临挑战，这证明了面向CDP评估的必要性以及MEGA-CDP在推动医疗LLM指南遵循方面的价值。

articles.title: Surgical Alignment in Knowledge Graph Training for Clinical Diagnosis with Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Biomedical knowledge graphs (KGs) offer structured medical knowledge that can ground large language model (LLM) reasoning in clinical diagnosis application, yet how KG signal should be integrated into LLMs remains an open question. We present a systematic study spanning five KG task formulations, three training paradigms, two KGs, and three base LLMs. At the task level, all paradigms improve over the non-finetuned baseline, but methods with comparable in-domain accuracy show substantially different knowledge transfer behavior. We introduce Gradient Intervention Density (GID) and Gradient Distortion (GD) to measure how broadly an optimizer modifies the pretrained model. GID and GD together reveal a clear divide: KG-judgment training under KL regularization produces sparse, localized updates (a regime we term as surgical alignment), while task-specific SFT produces dense ones. A controlled ablation shows that the objective and KL contribute to sparsity independently, and the paradigms that produce sparse updates also improve reasoning quality, even when their in-domain accuracy is lower than task-specific SFT. Assessing KG-LLM integration thus requires complementing accuracy with optimization-geometry diagnostics. Our implementation can be found at https://github.com/LARK-NLP-Lab/Surgical-Alignment.
articles.titleCn: 基于大型语言模型的临床诊断知识图谱训练中的手术对齐
articles.abstractCn: 生物医学知识图谱（KGs）提供了结构化的医学知识，能够为大型语言模型（LLM）在临床诊断应用中的推理提供基础，然而如何将KG信号整合到LLMs中仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们进行了一项系统性的研究，涵盖了五种KG任务形式、三种训练范式、两个KG以及三种基础LLM。在任务层面，所有范式都优于未微调的基线，但具有可比领域内准确性的方法表现出显著不同的知识迁移行为。我们引入了梯度干预密度（GID）和梯度扭曲（GD）来衡量优化器如何修改预训练模型。GID和GD共同揭示了一个明显的分界：在KL正则化下的KG判断训练产生稀疏、局部的更新（我们称之为手术对齐），而特定任务的SFT则产生密集的更新。受控的消融实验表明，目标函数和KL正则化独立地导致稀疏性，并且产生稀疏更新的范式也提高了推理质量，即使它们的领域内准确率低于特定任务的SFT。因此，评估KG-LLM的整合需要将准确率与优化几何诊断相结合。我们的实现代码可以在https://github.com/LARK-NLP-Lab/Surgical-Alignment找到。

articles.title: J-Zero: Unified Challenger--Solver--Judge Co-Evolution from Zero Data
articles.abstract: Self-evolving language models have recently emerged as a promising path toward superintelligence, with the advantage of reducing the cost of human supervision. While considerable progress has been made in verifiable domains, self-evolution in unverifiable domains remains substantially less explored. We propose Judge co-adaptation from Zero data (J-Zero), a unified Challenger--Solver--Judge co-evolution framework that supports self-improvement across both domains. The Challenger and Solver co-evolve through an adversarial interaction: the Challenger generates increasingly difficult tasks, while the Solver learns to produce higher-quality responses to them. In parallel, the Judge co-adapts using preference pairs whose ordering is known in advance from how each response was produced, i.e., the Solver's answer over the Challenger's, and its decomposed-and-recombined answer over its one-shot answer, rather than from the Judge's own scores. J-Zero outperforms the baselines by an average of 4.2 points on verifiable and 8.0 points on unverifiable domains, and continues to improve through at least ten iterations, whereas the baselines degrade after two.
articles.titleCn: J-Zero：零数据统一挑战者-求解器-裁判协同进化
articles.abstractCn: 自进化语言模型近来成为通往超级智能的可行途径，其优势在于降低人类监督成本。尽管在可验证领域取得了显著进展，但在不可验证领域的自进化仍远未得到充分探索。我们提出了从零数据判别协同适应（J-Zero），这是一个统一的挑战者-求解者-判别者协同进化框架，支持跨领域自我改进。挑战者和求解者通过对抗性交互协同进化：挑战者生成难度递增的任务，而求解者学习生成对这些任务的高质量响应。与此同时，判别者使用偏好对进行协同适应，这些偏好对的排序事先已知，即根据每个响应的生成方式确定——求解者的答案优于挑战者的答案，以及其分解后重组的答案优于其单次答案，而非判别者自身的评分。J-Zero在可验证领域平均优于基线4.2分，在不可验证领域平均优于基线8.0分，并且至少经过十次迭代仍持续改进，而基线在两次迭代后开始退化。

articles.title: Visual Information-Guided Parallel Decoding for Diffusion Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion multimodal large language models (dMLLMs) have recently emerged as a new decoding paradigm for multimodal generation. Starting from a fully masked sequence, dMLLMs progressively decode the sequence by unmasking a subset of the remaining masked positions at each step. Since the selected tokens serve as the prediction context for subsequent steps, deciding which tokens to decode is crucial to the quality of the final output. The most common strategy prioritizes tokens based on a certainty measure that tends to favor tokens frequently observed in the training data. Recent approaches instead order tokens according to their influence on subsequent predictions, but do not explicitly account for the input image. We propose the Visual Information-Guided Sampler (VIG-Sampler), which prioritizes tokens based on their attention to image tokens. We further impose a constraint that penalizes candidate tokens whose image-attention distributions are similar to those of previously selected tokens, thereby increasing the information gain of the decoded subset. Extensive experiments on 7 captioning and VQA benchmarks with 3 open-source dMLLMs demonstrate the effectiveness of VIG-Sampler, which outperforms the Info-Gain Sampler by an average of 19.3 CIDEr points across the captioning benchmarks and surpasses it on COCO Caption while using only half as many decoding steps.
articles.titleCn: 基于视觉信息引导的扩散多模态大语言模型并行解码
articles.abstractCn: 扩散多模态大语言模型（dMLLMs）近期已成为多模态生成的一种新解码范式。从完全掩码的序列开始，dMLLMs通过每一步逐步解码序列，解密剩余掩码位置的一个子集。由于所选的标记作为后续步骤的预测上下文，因此决定解码哪些标记对于最终输出的质量至关重要。最常见的策略是基于确定性度量优先考虑标记，这种度量倾向于偏爱在训练数据中频繁出现的标记。最近的方法则根据标记对后续预测的影响对标记进行排序，但并未明确考虑输入图像。我们提出了视觉信息引导采样器（VIG-Sampler），该采样器根据标记对图像标记的注意力来优先考虑标记。我们进一步施加了一个约束，惩罚那些图像注意力分布与先前所选标记相似的候选标记，从而增加解码子集的信息增益。在7个标题生成和VQA基准测试中，使用3个开源dMLLMs进行的广泛实验表明，VIG-Sampler非常有效，在标题生成基准测试中平均比信息增益采样器高19.3 CIDEr分，同时在COCO标题生成上使用仅一半的解码步骤就超越了它。

articles.title: Double Trouble: Bilingual Pretraining Leaves Language-Conditioned Effects in Shared-Language Representations
articles.abstract: When researchers compare multilingual models for probing, interpretability, or cross-lingual transfer, they often align embedding spaces and assume that shared-language representations are comparable. We show that this assumption can be premature for decoder-only models. We pretrain paired 310M-parameter models (one English-only, one bilingual) across eight typologically diverse languages, separately controlling for English exposure, total compute, and document overlap. After aligning on shared English vocabulary, we test held-out words and find that token embeddings look similar after alignment, but the deeper hidden states that the model uses for prediction do not. This gap holds for all eight languages and survives controls for document overlap and alternative alignment methods. This hidden-state mismatch grows through middle transformer layers, suggesting that it arises from contextual processing rather than the input representations where alignment is performed. Embedding alignment can mask real differences in how models internally represent a shared language, which matters for any downstream study that treats aligned models as interchangeable.
articles.comment: Published as a conference paper at EMNLP 2026 (Main)
articles.titleCn: 双重困境：双语预训练在共享语言表征中留下语言条件效应
articles.abstractCn: 当研究人员在探索多语言模型、可解释性或跨语言迁移时，他们通常会对齐嵌入空间，并假设共享语言的表示是可比的。我们表明，对于仅解码器模型而言，这一假设可能过于草率。我们跨八种类型学差异显著的语言预训练了310M参数的成对模型（一个仅英语，一个双语），分别控制英语接触、总计算量和文档重叠。在对齐共享英语词汇后，我们测试了未包含的单词，发现经过对齐后，词嵌入看起来相似，但模型用于预测的深层隐藏状态并不相似。这一差距适用于所有八种语言，并且在控制文档重叠和替代对齐方法后依然存在。这一隐藏状态不匹配随着中间Transformer层的深入而加剧，表明它源于上下文处理，而非对齐所进行的输入表示。嵌入对齐可能会掩盖模型在内部表示共享语言时的真实差异，这对任何将对齐模型视为可互换的下游研究都至关重要。

articles.title: Dependency-Aware Revocable Decoding for Efficient Diffusion Large Language Model Inference
articles.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer a promising alternative to autoregressive generation by decoding multiple tokens in parallel through iterative denoising. However, increasing decoding parallelism often degrades generation quality, as early errors can contaminate later contexts. Revocable decoding mitigates this issue by re-evaluating decoded tokens and remasking unreliable ones, but existing methods overlook that unreliable tokens may also corrupt the verification context itself. We identify this failure mode and propose Dependency-Aware Revocable Decoding (DARD), a training-free framework that separates tokens into masked, candidate, and unmasked states. DARD verifies candidate tokens using a selective context that excludes less reliable tokens and adaptively regulates their influence on subsequent decoding. Experiments across 12 textual and multimodal benchmarks on 3 open-source dLLMs show that DARD consistently improves the speed-quality Pareto frontier over recent revocable decoding methods, achieving a 2.71$\times$ speedup and a 4.35-point CIDEr score gain over Saber on Flickr30K.
articles.titleCn: 依赖感知可撤销解码，用于高效扩散大型语言模型推理
articles.abstractCn: 扩散大型语言模型（dLLMs）通过迭代去噪并行解码多个标记，为自回归生成提供了一种有前景的替代方案。然而，增加解码并行性往往会降低生成质量，因为早期的错误会污染后续的上下文。可撤销解码通过重新评估已解码的标记并重新掩码不可靠的标记来缓解这个问题，但现有方法忽略了不可靠的标记也可能污染验证上下文本身。我们识别了这种失效模式，并提出了一种无训练框架——依赖感知可撤销解码（DARD），该框架将标记分为掩码、候选和未掩码三种状态。DARD使用一个选择性上下文来验证候选标记，该上下文排除了不太可靠的标记，并自适应地调节它们对后续解码的影响。在3个开源dLLMs上的12个文本和多模态基准测试中，实验表明DARD始终优于近期的可撤销解码方法，在Flickr30K上比Saber实现了2.71倍的加速和4.35分的CIDEr分数提升。

articles.title: SPT: Skills as Pre-Training Data for Agentic Language Models
articles.abstract: Agentic (tool-using) language models are mainly trained on tool-call traces and agent trajectories during post-training. These data provide direct behavioral supervision, but producing them requires task environments, execution, and verification, making broad tool and task coverage expensive. Publicly available skills offer another source of training data: they encode reusable tool semantics and workflows but are typically used only as inference-time context. We introduce Skill Pre-Training (SPT), a mid-training method that applies causal language modeling to SkillCorpus, a collection of public multi-file skill packages, optionally mixed with general data. To preserve relations among files within each package, we also introduce Reference Insert, a reference-aware assembly strategy that places supporting files near their mentions in the primary instruction. Experiments across multiple model scales and post-training recipes show that SPT consistently improves agentic performance over mid-training on general or trajectory data, while largely preserving general performance. Data mixture experiments show additional benefits from combining skill data with general annealing corpora. These results indicate that skill packages are a valuable data source for pre-training agentic language models.
articles.titleCn: SPT：技能作为自主语言模型的预训练数据
articles.abstractCn: 基于工具使用的语言模型主要在训练后使用工具调用轨迹和智能体轨迹进行训练。这些数据提供了直接的行为监督，但生成它们需要任务环境、执行和验证，使得广泛覆盖工具和任务的成本很高。公开可用的技能提供了另一种训练数据来源：它们编码了可重用的工具语义和工作流程，但通常仅用作推理时的上下文。我们引入了技能预训练（SPT），这是一种中期训练方法，将因果语言模型应用于技能语料库（SkillCorpus），这是一个包含公开多文件技能包的集合，并可选择性地混合通用数据。为了保留每个包内文件之间的关系，我们还引入了引用插入（Reference Insert），这是一种具有引用感知的组装策略，将支持文件放置在主指令中提及它们的位置附近。跨多个模型规模和训练后配方进行的实验表明，SPT始终在通用数据或轨迹数据的中期训练上提升了智能体性能，同时基本保留了通用性能。数据混合实验表明，将技能数据与通用退火语料库结合可以带来额外的好处。这些结果表明，技能包是预训练智能体语言模型的有价值的数据来源。

articles.title: SPEAR: Distilling Domain-Adaptive Reasoning Skeletons via Sequential Symbolic Alignment in Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning-based knowledge distillation has the potential to transfer complex reasoning from teacher to student models, yet it currently faces a critical dilemma: researchers must choose between sparse outcome-based rewards, which provide insufficient logical guidance, or expensive neural Process Reward Models (PRMs) for dense signals. We resolve this by introducing SPEAR (Symbolic Process Evaluation and Alignment Reward), a training-free and plug-and-play process reward method for sequence-level on-policy distillation. SPEAR projects natural-language reasoning traces into domain-adaptive symbolic milestones, providing an efficient proxy for process-level reasoning alignment. By utilizing the longest common subsequence (LCS) to align student explorations with teacher milestones, SPEAR provides a dense, order-aware reward signal that enforces logical consistency without the need for an external neural verifier. Our experiments across math, science, and commonsense reasoning tasks demonstrate that SPEAR effectively bridges the reasoning gap between student and teacher models via sequence-level distillation with efficient dense process rewards. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/zhuochunli/SPEAR.
articles.titleCn: SPEAR：通过强化学习中的序列符号对齐蒸馏领域自适应推理骨架
articles.abstractCn: 基于强化学习的知识蒸馏有潜力将复杂的推理从教师模型迁移到学生模型，但目前面临一个关键困境：研究人员必须在稀疏的基于结果奖励（提供不足的逻辑指导）和昂贵的神经过程奖励模型（PRMs）之间做出选择，后者用于密集信号。我们通过引入SPEAR（符号过程评估与对齐奖励），一种无需训练且即插即用的过程奖励方法，用于序列级在线策略蒸馏，来解决这个问题。SPEAR将自然语言推理轨迹投影到领域自适应的符号里程碑，为过程级推理对齐提供了一个高效的代理。通过利用最长公共子序列（LCS）来对齐学生探索与教师里程碑，SPEAR提供了一种密集的、顺序感知的奖励信号，在无需外部神经验证器的情况下强制执行逻辑一致性。我们的数学、科学和常识推理任务实验表明，SPEAR通过高效的密集过程奖励的序列级蒸馏，有效地弥合了学生模型和教师模型之间的推理差距。我们的代码和数据可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/zhuochunli/SPEAR。

articles.title: DuMateBench: Evaluating Autonomous Agents in Complex Real-World Workflows
articles.abstract: Autonomous agents are increasingly adopted to complete complex, multi-tool workflows in real-world settings. However, existing benchmarks typically separate tasks by application or capability and evaluate agents in environments that are cleaner and more stable than those encountered in practice. We introduce DuMateBench, a real-session benchmark reconstructed from anonymized and privacy-screened user sessions collected from a large-scale production agent platform. Each task preserves the relevant pre-solution interaction history, persistent configurations, and workspace state, and is then validated through human verification. The resulting benchmark comprises 200 tasks spanning 8 broad scenarios and 17 fine-grained capability categories, with most tasks requiring multiple capability coordination. We execute these tasks in isolated Docker containers injected with three forms of real-world environmental complexity: Insufficient, Unstable, and Noisy, and assess performance using a hybrid deterministic and LLM-as-Judge evaluation protocol. Experiments across five representative autonomous-agent frameworks paired with four state-of-the-art LLMs reveal substantial gaps in strict task completion. Complementary robustness, efficiency, and diagnostic analyses further show that performance under environmental perturbations is jointly shaped by the capabilities of the LLM and the surrounding agent framework. The code and data are publicly available at https://dumatebench.com/.
articles.titleCn: DuMateBench：评估复杂现实工作流程中的自主代理
articles.abstractCn: 自主代理正越来越多地被用于在现实场景中完成复杂的多工具工作流。然而，现有的基准测试通常按应用或能力划分任务，并在比实际遇到的环境更干净、更稳定的环境中评估代理。我们介绍了DuMateBench，这是一个从大型生产代理平台收集的匿名化和隐私屏蔽的用户会话中重建的真实会话基准。每个任务都保留了相关的预解决方案交互历史、持久配置和工作区状态，并通过人工验证进行确认。由此产生的基准包含200个任务，涵盖8个广泛场景和17个细粒度能力类别，其中大多数任务需要多种能力协调。我们在隔离的Docker容器中执行这些任务，并注入三种形式的现实环境复杂性：不足、不稳定和嘈杂，并采用混合确定性以及LLM作为法官的评估协议来评估性能。跨越五个代表性自主代理框架和四种最先进的LLM的实验揭示了在严格任务完成方面存在巨大差距。补充的鲁棒性、效率和诊断分析进一步表明，在环境扰动下的性能是由LLM的能力和周围代理框架的能力共同塑造的。代码和数据可在https://dumatebench.com/上公开获取。

articles.title: Multi-Expert Conformal Risk Control for Pairwise LLM Judging in Open-Ended Dialogue
articles.abstract: In this paper, we explore multi-expert Conformal Risk Control (CRC) algorithms for pairwise LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation in open-ended dialogue. Our core insight is that multi-expert aggregation offers a complementary remedy to CRC: whereas CRC controls risk at the decision threshold through abstention, aggregation sanitizes the scoring function at its source. Guided by this, we first design two multi-expert CRC methods: Score Averaging and Decision Voting, which aggregate at the score and decision levels, respectively. While both strategies outperform single-expert methods on homogeneous expert panels, on heterogeneous LLM judges they remain risk-valid but recover only limited coverage, because a uniform threshold cannot match the experts' distinct scoring scales. To resolve this issue, we further propose Marginal-Calibrated Conformal Consensus (MC3): it captures distinct per-expert scales via initial threshold ratios, while jointly tuning a unified decision function $C_t(x)$ applied identically in both calibration and test, thereby preserving exchangeability. To evaluate our framework, we construct Panel, a 1,800-pair human pairwise-preference benchmark for open-ended dialogue. It is built on responses generated by four open-weight LLMs over dialogue contexts from three domains (ESConv, MSC, DREAM), with full logit access. In experiments, we find that both Score Averaging and Decision Voting substantially improve accuracy and acceptance rate on homogeneous panels. Notably, MC3 extends these gains to heterogeneous panels by accommodating distinct per-expert scoring scales across all three datasets.
articles.titleCn: 开放式对话中成对LLM评判的多专家一致性风险控制
articles.abstractCn: 在本文中，我们探讨了用于开放式对话中成对LLM作为评判者评估的多专家一致性风险控制（CRC）算法。我们的核心见解是，多专家聚合为CRC提供了一种补充性的解决方案：CRC通过弃权在决策阈值处控制风险，而聚合则在评分函数的源头进行净化。基于此，我们首先设计了两种多专家CRC方法：评分平均法和决策投票法，分别在不同层面进行聚合。尽管这两种策略在同质专家面板上优于单专家方法，但在异质LLM评判者上，它们仍然保持风险有效性，但仅能恢复有限的覆盖率，因为统一的阈值无法匹配专家们不同的评分尺度。为解决这一问题，我们进一步提出了边际校准一致性（MC3）：它通过初始阈值比率捕获每个专家的独特尺度，同时联合调整一个在校准和测试中相同应用的统一决策函数$C_t(x)$，从而保持可交换性。为评估我们的框架，我们构建了Panel，一个包含1800对开放式对话人类成对偏好的基准。它基于四个开放权重LLM在三个领域（ESConv、MSC、DREAM）的对话上下文中生成的响应，并具有完整的logit访问权限。在实验中，我们发现评分平均法和决策投票法在同质面板上显著提高了准确率和接受率。值得注意的是，MC3通过在所有三个数据集上适应每个专家的独特评分尺度，将这些收益扩展到了异质面板。

articles.title: Sycophancy Suppression Can Impair Rational Updating: Anti-Sycophancy Should Preserve the Ability to Update
articles.abstract: Large language models often exhibit sycophancy, revising their answers to align with users when users push back. Such answer flips, however, can arise from different causes. One possibility is that the model simply aligns with the user's feedback in order to satisfy them. Another is that the feedback genuinely contains useful evidence, prompting the model to update its answer in a rational way. We distinguish them as Unsupported-Yielding and Rational-Updating. Prior work focuses primarily on suppressing Unsupported-Yielding, while overlooking its effect on Rational-Updating. We address this gap with a two-turn evaluation framework that measures the two behaviors separately. Across representative training-time and inference-time interventions, we find that anti-sycophancy methods often encounter a trade-off in which reducing Unsupported-Yielding can sacrifice Rational-Updating, and vice versa, even when the two objectives are optimized jointly. Mechanistic analysis suggests that the two behaviors share an internal substrate: the MLP neurons and attention heads driving them overlap substantially, and their associated steering directions are positively aligned. We further conduct a preliminary orthogonalized steering exploration, which yields modest, backbone-dependent selectivity gains. Overall, our results suggest that anti-sycophancy should be treated not as a simple suppression problem, but as a selectivity problem, where effective interventions should preserve Rational-Updating while reducing Unsupported-Yielding.
articles.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Findings. Code and data: https://github.com/dependentsign/sycophancy-rational-updating
articles.titleCn: 谄媚抑制可能损害理性更新：反谄媚应保持更新能力
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型常常表现出谄媚行为，当用户提出反对意见时，会修改其答案以迎合用户。然而，这种答案的逆转可能由不同的原因引起。一种可能性是模型仅仅为了取悦用户而与其反馈保持一致。另一种可能性是反馈中确实包含有用的证据，促使模型以合理的方式更新其答案。我们将这两种情况分别称为"不受支持让步"和"理性更新"。以往的研究主要集中于抑制不受支持让步，而忽略了它对理性更新的影响。我们通过一个两轮评估框架来解决这个问题，该框架能够分别测量这两种行为。在代表性的训练时和推理时干预措施中，我们发现反谄媚方法常常面临权衡：减少不受支持让步可能会牺牲理性更新，反之亦然，即使两个目标被共同优化。机制分析表明，这两种行为共享一个内部基础：驱动它们的MLP神经元和注意力头显著重叠，并且它们相关的引导方向是正相关的。我们进一步进行了初步的正交引导探索，获得了适度且依赖于主干的选择性增益。总体而言，我们的结果表明，反谄媚不应被视为一个简单的抑制问题，而是一个选择性问题，有效的干预措施应在减少不受支持让步的同时保留理性更新。

articles.title: A Single Suffix to Break Them All: Basin-Aware Jailbreaks for Merged Model Families
articles.abstract: Model merging enables combining multiple fine-tuned models without additional training, but its safety implications remain poorly understood. Prior work primarily attributes merging risks to unsafe constituent models, implicitly assuming that merging individually aligned models preserves safety. In contrast, we show that model merging reveals a previously overlooked jailbreak risk rooted in the pretrained foundation model, even when all constituent models are individually safety-aligned. Motivated by this observation, we study a new threat setting where an attacker constructs jailbreak prompts that generalize across merged models sharing the same pretrained backbone, without access to the exact merging coefficients or constituent checkpoints. To exploit this phenomenon, we propose \textbf{Basin-Aware Jailbreak (BAJ)}, which formulates jailbreak generation as a min--max optimization over the merging space to produce transferable adversarial suffixes across merged model families. Experiments across diverse backbones and merging settings show that BAJ achieves consistently high transfer success rates and remains effective under existing defenses.
articles.titleCn: 一个后缀破局：面向合并模型家族的盆地感知越狱
articles.abstractCn: 模型合并能够将多个微调模型结合在一起，而无需额外的训练，但其安全影响仍然缺乏了解。先前的研究主要将合并风险归因于不安全的组成模型，隐含地假设将单独对齐的模型合并可以保持安全。相反，我们表明，模型合并揭示了一种先前被忽视的越狱风险，这种风险源于预训练的基础模型，即使所有组成模型都单独对齐安全也是如此。基于这一观察，我们研究了一种新的威胁场景，其中攻击者构建越狱提示，这些提示可以泛化到共享相同预训练主干网络的合并模型，而无需访问确切的合并系数或组成检查点。为了利用这一现象，我们提出了\textbf{Basin-Aware Jailbreak (BAJ)}，它将越狱生成表述为在合并空间上的最小-最大优化，以生成可迁移的对抗性后缀，跨越合并模型家族。在多种主干网络和合并设置上的实验表明，BAJ始终实现了高迁移成功率，并在现有防御措施下保持有效。

articles.title: Zero-Shot Self-Orchestration with Ledger-Based Control for Improved LLM Coding Performance
articles.abstract: Multi-agent large language model systems are widely reported to beat single-model baselines, but the evidence is mixed, and comparisons are usually confounded: pipelines change token budgets, tool calls, and prompts simultaneously, so an aggregate gain rarely reveals what actually helped. We investigate the effect of introducing the manager-worker scaffold over a shared filesystem workspace, with no training and no per-benchmark tuning, measured against the same model answering in a single pass. Across nine models -- five open-weight, spanning 9B to ~2.8T parameters, and four frontier closed models -- on the 100 latest hard LiveCodeBench problems, the scaffold's benefit is real but conditional: large and statistically significant for some (Qwen3.8-27B +23.4, GPT-5.6-Luna +10.6 and GPT-5.6-Terra +8.0, each over five paired passes; Kimi-K3 +30.4 and Minimax-M3 +11.0 over five paired passes with reasoning off, both at $p < 10^{-4}$, and +42 and +12 in a single pass at a 128k cap) and null or negative for others (Qwen3.6-35B -1 to -9 with reasoning off). With the manager, Opus-5 achieves the highest score in the study at 91% in one pass. Running a manager roughly triples the token bill, but it buys accuracy more cheaply than moving to a larger model does: GPT-5.6-Terra with a manager nearly matches Fable 5's single-call accuracy (85.0 against 87.4, $p = 0.59$) at a fifth of the price (\$11.71 against \$61.11 per 100-problem pass, $p < 10^{-4}$), and the Qwen-27B arm does it for \$51.75 on weights anyone can self-host. Our transcript analysis finds several mechanisms behind the gains, of which two recur: context management, in which short worker calls and shared notes organize state and reduce truncation, and problem decomposition. Improvements are modest for large models with reasoning enabled, but larger for some models with reasoning disabled and for smaller models with reasoning enabled.
articles.titleCn: 基于账本控制的零样本自我编排以提升大型语言模型编程性能
articles.abstractCn: 多智能体大型语言模型系统被广泛报道优于单模型基线，但证据并不一致，且比较通常存在混杂因素：管道同时改变令牌预算、工具调用和提示，因此综合收益很少揭示实际起作用的原因。我们研究了在共享文件系统工作空间中引入管理-工作脚手架的效果，无需训练且无需针对每个基准进行微调，并与单次通过中回答相同问题的模型进行对比。在九个模型——五个开放权重模型（参数规模从9B到~2.8T不等），以及四个前沿封闭模型——在最新的100个LiveCodeBench难题上，该脚手架的收益是真实存在的但具有条件性：对某些模型效果显著（Qwen3.8-27B +23.4，GPT-5.6-Luna +10.6和GPT-5.6-Terra +8.0，均超过五次配对通过；Kimi-K3 +30.4和Minimax-M3 +11.0在推理关闭时通过五次配对通过，均$p < 10^{-4}$，且在128k限制下单次通过分别达到+42和+12），而对另一些模型则无效或为负（Qwen3.6-35B在推理关闭时为-1至-9）。使用管理器时，Opus-5在单次通过中取得了研究中的最高分数，达到91%。运行管理器大约将令牌开销增加两倍，但它以比转向更大模型更低的成本购买了准确性：带有管理器的GPT-5.6-Terra几乎与Fable 5的单次调用准确性相当（85.0对87.4，$p = 0.59$），但价格仅为五分之一（\$11.71对\$61.11每100题通过，$p < 10^{-4}$），而Qwen-27B分支则花费\$51.75，其权重任何人都可以自行托管。我们的文本分析发现了几个背后的收益机制，其中有两个反复出现：上下文管理，即短工作调用和共享笔记组织状态并减少截断，以及问题分解。对于启用推理的大型模型，改进幅度较小，但对于推理关闭的某些模型以及启用推理的小型模型，改进幅度更大。
